The Role

We are seeking an experienced Optimization Data Analyst to join our team in San Francisco to play a critical role in driving scalable optimizations and advanced analytics across Adyen’s global Performance Optimization team. As an Optimization Data Analyst, you will independently lead complex analyses, support automation and experimentation projects, and collaborate with commercial and product stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that maximize merchant growth.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst looking to deepen technical impact while influencing product and business outcomes at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Data-Driven Optimization- Analyze large-scale payment datasets to identify performance trends, uncover optimization opportunities, and deliver high-impact recommendations to our biggest customers, while identifying and driving scalable opportunities that benefit the broader merchant base.
  • Scalable Tooling & Automation- Design and build scalable analytics solutions, automation pipelines, and self-service tools that empower internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration- Partner with Product, Data, and Commercial teams to translate business challenges into analytical solutions, driving continuous platform improvements.
  • Advanced Problem-Solving & Experimentation- Lead complex A/B testing and data investigations, shaping data-driven strategies and validating hypotheses with analytical rigor.
  • Strategic Data Storytelling- Drive strategic discussions by synthesizing complex data into compelling narratives, tailoring insights for technical and non-technical audiences, and positioning the Performance Optimization team as a key business enabler.
  • Mentorship & Best Practices- Support knowledge-sharing within the Performance Optimization team, contributing to the elevation of analytical standards and technical excellence.

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in a data analytics, data science, or similar role, ideally in fintech, payments, or a high-growth tech environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark, with hands-on experience in large-scale data processing.
  • Ability to design and develop efficient and scalable ETL and data pipelines for datasets, including the use of data validations to ensure reliability.
  • Familiarity with big data tools (Spark, Airflow) and version control using Git.
  • Solid experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) and dashboard development.
  • Deep understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, and data mining.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence product and business outcomes.
  • Proactive, self-directed, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, global environment.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, translating data insights into business value.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $132,000 - $178,000, plus RSUs; to learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click here.

Location

This role is based out of our San Francisco office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

Title: Staff Data Analyst, Block Compliance
Description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

The Staff Data Analyst will join the Block Compliance Analytics team chartered to put data at the center of the Compliance organization. You have a proven track record in the Financial Crimes and AML space, and in this role you will develop strategies and lead key workstreams to deliver actionable analytics to leaders throughout the Block business and tell the story of our Compliance program to regulators and external parties. Focused on quantifying compliance risks and driving effectiveness, you will enable Block to redefine the world's relationship with money.

You Will


Lead data strategy for our regulatory engagements - from ETL development to source data validation to analysis
Connect the dots between regulatory expectations, commitments, and the Compliance and Product roadmaps in order to influence strategy
Harness raw data to educate internal and external partners on the impact of new regulation, policies, or environmental changes to our compliance program and the Block platforms.
Collaborate with partners from legal to engineering to inform strategic builds of essential compliance program elements
Establish yourself as a leader in the organization, by connecting insights to action through expert communication and cross-functional alignment
Leverage your subject matter expertise to educate, coach and influence in and out of the organization with a focus on contributing to the overall, long-term success of Block
Lead multiple high-impact workstreams, through ability to seamlessly navigate levels of abstraction in written and verbal communications.


You Have


8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6+ years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent work experience.
5+ years of Compliance/AML experience
Expert level abilities in SQL and data analysis/visualization tools (i.e. Tableau, Looker)
Expert in ETL development
Proven track record solving large and complex problems without clear answers, using deep and broad technical expertise
Vision to define problems and manage projects in a fast-paced, evolving organization
Experience bringing data to life for any audience through written and verbal communication and data visualization.
Impeccable attention to detail and polish


Even Better (but Not Required)


CAMS or other AML certification
Experience in the FinTech or consulting industry or with financial crimes compliance systems, technologies and processes.
Experience with automation using Python, R or Prefect

Title: Operations Data Analyst, Principal
Description:
Requisition ID # 171773

Job Category: Business Operations / Strategy

Job Level: Manager/Principal

Business Unit: Strategy & Growth

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Oakland

Department Overview

The System Performance, Reliability and Resiliency Strategy team within the overall Electric Transmission and Distribution Engineering organization is responsible for planning, organizing, and managing the resources necessary to successfully execute PG&E’s Electric Reliability Strategy and initiatives. This team of forward–thinking individuals is tasked with deploying the technology and infrastructure to achieve the company’s reliability goals. The team is responsible for implementing programs required to modernize the electric grid allowing for safe, resilient and efficient operations.

Position Summary

Extracts operations data for analysis, leadership support and responses to ad hoc data requests. Maintains operations tools & databases to ensure that it is kept up-to-date. Develops, maintains and enhances operational metric database tools for the broader analytics teams. Identifies and solves current gaps in data requirements and ease of access to ensure fast and consistent responses to leadership inquiries. Synthesizes insights from large, complex datasets—often across multiple systems—to support strategic decision-making, including operational planning, budget forecasting, and executive-level reporting.

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory. Bay Area preferred. In office (Dublin or Oakland) 2-3 days a week.

PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.

Bay Minimum: $140,000

Bay Maximum: $238,000

&/OR

CA Minimum: $133,000

CA Maximum: $226,000

This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Job Responsibilities


Manages very complex data analysis projects with very limited supervision from initial request to presenting data results ensuring that the project is completed within budget and on-time.
Acts as a thought leader applying extensive data processing and data analysis expertise through advanced analytics platforms (e.g., Palantir Foundry or similar data integration environments) in the development of strategy or resolution to complex data issues. Creates very complex automated data routines and processes for reporting and data delivery ensuring accurate data manipulation and data cleansing.
Manages major and complex cross functional data projects that have broad company implications.
Supports operational and strategic planning through data-driven budget development, forecasting, and variance analysis to inform leadership decisions.
Manages extracting data and transferring the data from databases to various analysts to support operational analysis efforts.
Analyzes data using various advanced statistical tools to develop complex ad hoc reports, statistics, trends and profiles.
Develops and synthesizes complex and disparate datasets into clear, executive-ready insights, comprehensive reports and analysis for long-term, company-wide issues. Presents/communicates clear, concise and actionable data analyses identifying trends, risks, and opportunities across operational, financial, and performance dimensions for clients.
Exhibits leadership and executive level communication capability, effectively influencing outcomes through data driven insights.
Serves as a role model for analytical rigor, professional judgment, and executive level communication.
May work with Senior Management to develop business related strategy, leveraging data in decision making.


Qualifications

Minimum:


Bachelors Degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, Engineering or other related field or equivalent work experience
Job-related experience, 8 years


Desired:


Masters Degree or equivalent experience
Familiarity with utility operations
Familiarity with SAP
Advanced skill in Microsoft Excel/Access (complex formulas, graphing, VBA)
Advanced skill in writing SQL queries using Oracle or Business Objects
Strong knowledge of base-SAS and programming language such as Visual Basic, Perl, C
Strong organizational, prioritization and multi-tasking skills. Advanced communication and presentation skills to deliver highly complex data and findings to Sr. Management.
Expertise in project management to lead large, cross functional projects and develop concise data findings for Sr. Management.

Title: Data Analyst, In-Store
Description:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…


Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.
Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilities
Partner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.
Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.
Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis


We're Excited About You Because…


A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.
Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.
Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.


Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. Title: Hardware Data Analyst
Description:
Aperia is unlocking a new era of efficiency and sustainability for commercial vehicle fleets, by developing innovative hardware and data analytics solutions. Inventors of the award- winning and disruptive Halotm Automatic Tire Inflator, and the cloud delivered Halo Connect tire analytics platform. Aperia saves fleets thousands of hours of down-time every week, reduces the carbon footprint and environmental impact of the freight industry. Join us as we expand our product offering and take the next steps on our journey toward bringing the "backbone of our economy" into the automation age.

We are unable to sponsor H-1B visas or other employment-based visas for this position at this time.

Your Role

As a Hardware Data Analyst, you will harness vast amounts of data streaming from our extensive deployment of telematics and IoT devices in the field. Your work will directly impact our hardware systems' performance, reliability, and efficiency, helping deliver exceptional customer experiences. Collaborating with engineering, product management, data science, and customer support teams, you will process and analyze sensor and analytics data to uncover insights, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement.

Your Responsibilities


Design and deliver dashboards, reports, and presentations using tools like QuickSight, Tableau, or Python libraries to visualize performance metrics and communicate findings effectively.
Continuously monitor and analyze incoming sensor and analytics data to identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues in the field.
Use statistical models and machine learning techniques to extract insights and generate actionable recommendations for hardware reliability and performance improvements.
Compare outputs from various firmware versions to validate improvements or detect unexpected regressions.
Collaborate with hardware engineers, product managers, and data scientists to define and execute data analysis strategies.
Support customer support teams by providing data-driven insights to address product performance and anomaly-related inquiries.
Proactively identify and propose new tools, methods, or processes to enhance data analysis capabilities and improve operational efficiency.
Collaborate with the engineering and data science teams to design and implement data pipelines that ensure reliable ingestion, processing, and storage of large-scale field data.
Act as a data advocate within the organization, ensuring teams have the necessary data access and tools to make informed decisions.
Collaborate with product development teams to ensure field data is incorporated into the design of future hardware and software features.


Skills/Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
2-4 years of experience in data analysis, with exposure to hardware-related roles or IoT systems preferred.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, MATLAB, or Excel for data analysis and modeling.
Demonstrated experience with visualization tools like Quicksight, Tableau, Streamlit, or Looker.
Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, and time-series data analysis.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS (S3, Redshift, Kinesis, IoT Core) or similar is a plus.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate data findings into actionable insights.
Excellent communication skills to present complex data in a clear, concise manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Pay Range: $110,000 - $123,000


Base salary only. Salary is dependent on multiple factors including, but not limited to, experience and location.
Additional compensation may include equity, bonuses, stipends, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and long-term disability insurance.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Hardware & Supply Chain
Description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst — Hardware & Supply Chain to join our Data Analytics team in North America. You’ll be the analytics lead on the data that runs Oura’s physical business—how rings are built, sourced, manufactured, shipped, sold, activated, and serviced. This is the data behind hardware manufacturing, supply chain, revenue, units sold, COGS, margin, inventory, and the warranty and returns metrics that show up in board and S-1 reporting.

As Oura matures into a scalable consumer-hardware business and migrates to a unified data platform on Databricks, this role exists to make sure the numbers that leadership and external auditors steer by—units sold, sell-through, activation rate, on-hand inventory, landed cost, and warranty rate—are defined once, computed correctly, traceable end-to-end from ERP and the manufacturing floor to the executive dashboard, and audit-ready. You will partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Finance, and Data Engineering to build the governed hardware /supply chain data foundation.

What You Will Do

Hardware & Supply Chain KPI Ownership


Own the analytics layer for the hardware and supply chain scorecard — partner with Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to define, document, and deliver the KPIs that show up in board and S-1 reporting (hardware revenue, units sold, sell-through, COGS, landed cost, gross margin, on-hand and in-transit inventory, warranty rate, return/RMA rate, and activation rate).
Establish each hardware/SC KPI as a governed, audit-grade data product — locked definitions, single owner, data build tool (dbt) tests, full lineage from source systems, formal sign-off, and a documented change-management process.
Build and own the hardware data contract and hardware — the canonical dimension that ties SKUs, components, ring generations, sizes, and finishes to every downstream sales, inventory, and activation metric.
Be the analytics representative in external audit cycles — produce documentation, walk auditors through lineage, and ensure controls and traceability are reflected in how hardware and supply chain metrics are produced.


Platform Migration & Data Engineering


Migrate hardware and supply chain reporting from legacy stacks (Snowflake + Tableau + Sheets) to our Databricks-based platform, with dbt-modeled metrics, Unity Catalog lineage, and Databricks SQL / Genie as the executive-facing surface.
Coordinate with source-system owners across ERP, manufacturing, logistics, and e-commerce (NetSuite, contract-manufacturer feeds, 3PL/logistics data, Zuora) and the Data Engineering team to ensure clean ingestion, correct dimensional modeling, and clear lineage from purchase orders and factory output through to sell-through and activation.
Resolve systems data quality issue to ensure that reporting is trustworthy end to end.
Build and maintain the Hardware/SC domain’s data products in Databricks, mentoring analysts on dimensional modeling, dbt practices, and the Golden Path for publishing governed metrics for reporting and for MCP/agentic AI consumption.


Operations & Supply Chain Partnership


Partner deeply with Supply Chain and Operations on demand/supply planning data — own the Databricks-side data layer that feeds planning, and ensure planned, reported, and warehouse numbers reconcile across regions.
Deliver inventory, fulfillment, and supplier analytics — days of supply, fill rate, on-time delivery, yield, scrap, and cost-to-serve — that give Operations leadership a single trusted view.
Drive adoption of self-service reporting by Operations and business partners — using Genie, Databricks SQL dashboards, and clear documentation to reduce one-off reporting and free up analyst time for analysis.


Tooling & Innovation


Continuously evaluate emerging tools (Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, AI-assisted SQL/modeling via Cursor and Claude Code, semantic-layer technologies) to improve productivity and accuracy in hardware and supply chain reporting.


We Would Love to Have You on Our Team, If You Have


7+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a related data-focused role, with at least 3+ years specifically supporting Hardware, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, or Logistics.
Demonstrated experience building executive-level reporting for a physical-product business that is trusted by leadership and survives external scrutiny (Board, auditors, investors).
Deep working knowledge of hardware and supply chain data domains: units sold and sell-through, COGS and landed cost, BOM and component costing, inventory (on-hand, in-transit, days of supply), warranty and RMA/returns, manufacturing yield, and how transactional systems (NetSuite/ERP, contract-manufacturer and 3PL feeds, e-commerce platforms) flow into reported numbers.
Hands-on experience with demand/supply planning data and a real understanding of where the planning system ends and the data lake begins.
Highly fluent in SQL with experience writing complex queries for operational and financial data extraction, reconciliation, and modeling.
Expertise in dimensional modeling for hardware/operations reporting (conformed dimensions across SKU, product generation, channel, geo, supplier; slowly-changing dimensions for product and cost hierarchies; period-over-period comparisons).
Experience with dbt — including tests, documentation, exposures, and contracts.

Title: CX Data Analyst
Description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Customer Experience runs on data — but right now, that data lives in too many places, speaks too many languages, and reaches the wrong people too late. This role exists to fix that.

As Harvey's first Support Operations Data Analyst, you'll own the analytics function for the Customer Experience org. You'll build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and feedback loops that tell us whether we're hitting our north stars — cSAT, TTR, QA scores, escalation rates — and surface the signal underneath the numbers so we can act on it. You'll sit within the Support Operations team, reporting to the Support Operations Manager, and work closely with Customer Experience leadership and Harvey's central data team to ensure the org is equipped with the right instrumentation as we scale.

This is a solo role. You won't have a team beneath you. You will need to be fluent enough in support analytics to hold the function independently, confident enough to push back on how metrics are framed, and fast enough to operate at Harvey's pace.

What You'll Do


Own recurring reporting for Customer Experience — weekly, monthly, and QBR-ready — tailored to ops, leadership, and cross-functional audiences
Translate support data into clear narratives: what's happening, why, and what to do about it
Track and maintain north star metrics: cSAT, TTR by tier, QA scores, bug escalation rate to EPD, and First Response Time
Build and maintain self-serve dashboards that give the ops team and leadership real-time visibility into support performance
Partner with Support Systems to ensure Zendesk is instrumented to capture the data we need
Work with Harvey's central data team to connect support data to broader product and customer data sources
Identify and close data collection gaps — if we can't measure it, help define how we should
Design feedback loops that connect support signals to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success
Quantify the operational cost of product bugs, feature gaps, and onboarding failures
Contribute to QA analytics as the QA program matures
Track ticket deflection, AI/chatbot performance, and self-service effectiveness
Measure the impact of AI-driven support — containment rate, escalation rate from AI interactions, resolution quality — and surface findings that drive how we tune and invest in those tools
Support ad hoc analytical requests from the Support Operations Manager, Customer Experience leadership, and senior stakeholders


Required

What You Have


3–5 years of experience in analytics, with at least 2 years directly in support operations, customer success operations, or a closely adjacent function
Fluency in support platform data — you know how Zendesk (or equivalent) is structured, what data it produces, and what it doesn't
SQL proficiency — you can write complex queries against large datasets without hand-holding (CTEs, window functions, joins across schemas)
Dashboard experience — you've built and maintained operational dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Omni, or equivalent
Reporting for multiple audiences — you know the difference between what a frontline manager needs and what a CFO needs, and you build accordingly
Strong data storytelling — you don't just present numbers, you write the narrative
Comfort operating solo — you don't need a team around you to deliver, and you don't need a ticket to tell you what to look at


Strong Plus


Experience with Python for data manipulation or automation
Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tooling
Experience building or contributing to QA analytics programs
Background supporting enterprise SaaS or AI-native products
Experience working with Zendesk APIs or extracting data beyond standard reporting


Key Attributes


AI-native: you use AI tooling actively in your analytical workflows — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier
Pace: you move in hours and days, not weeks. You surface findings before anyone has to ask
Judgment: you know which metrics matter and which are vanity. You push back when framing is wrong
Clarity: your outputs are direct, jargon-free, and actionable. You write for the reader, not yourself
Ownership: you treat Customer Experience analytics as your problem to solve, not a ticket queue to process


Compensation

$112,000 - $168,000 USD

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

Title: Sr. Customer & Business Data Analyst II
Description:
About Slickdeals:

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you’ll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:


Drive strategic and operational analysis. Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior. Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
Size new products and growth opportunities. Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
Validate new and evolving data sources. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
Proactively identify and answer important business questions. Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
Influence decisions through clear communication. Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.


What We're Looking For:


7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.


Nice to Have:


Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.


How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:


Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.
Explain complex analytical findings simply and persuasively.
Communicate that point of view clearly enough to influence senior-level decisions.
Use emerging tools, including AI, to materially increase your analytical leverage and speed.
Build a deep understanding of how Slickdeals works and use that context to continually improve the questions we ask.


This is not a role focused primarily on producing dashboards or fulfilling a queue of analytical requests. We are looking for someone who wants to own important business questions from beginning to end and whose work will directly influence how Slickdeals operates and where we invest.

Because of the breadth of the role and its exposure to senior leadership, this position represents an opportunity to have an outsized impact on both Slickdeals' near-term performance and its long-term strategic direction.

LOCATION: San Mateo, CA

Hybrid schedule visiting our San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).

Slickdeals Compensation, Benefits, Perks:

The expected base pay for this role is between $153,000 - $186,000. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Exact compensation will be discussed during the interview process and tailored to the candidate's qualifications.


Competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity package
Competitive paid time off in addition to holiday time off
A variety of healthcare insurance plans to give you the best care for your needs
401K matching above the industry standard
Professional Development Reimbursement Program

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you’ll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive strategic and operational analysis. Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior. Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
  • Size new products and growth opportunities. Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
  • Validate new and evolving data sources. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
  • Proactively identify and answer important business questions. Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
  • Influence decisions through clear communication. Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
  • Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
  • Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
  • A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
  • Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
  • Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
  • Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
  • Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
  • BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
  • Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
  • Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
  • Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
  • Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
  • A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
  • Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
  • Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.

How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:

  • Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
  • Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
  • Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
  • Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
  • Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
  • Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
  • Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.
  • Explain complex analytical findings simply and persuasively.
  • Communicate that point of view clearly enough to influence senior-level decisions.
  • Use emerging tools, including AI, to materially increase your analytical leverage and speed.
  • Build a deep understanding of how Slickdeals works and use that context to continually improve the questions we ask.

This is not a role focused primarily on producing dashboards or fulfilling a queue of analytical requests. We are looking for someone who wants to own important business questions from beginning to end and whose work will directly influence how Slickdeals operates and where we invest.

Because of the breadth of the role and its exposure to senior leadership, this position represents an opportunity to have an outsized impact on both Slickdeals' near-term performance and its long-term strategic direction.

LOCATION: San Mateo, CA

Hybrid schedule visiting our San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).

Title: Sustainability Data Analyst
Description:
Location: United States - Remote

About The Role

Worldly is seeking a Sustainability Data Analyst with a passion for deep, detailed work with complex data. This person will partner with teams across Worldly to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of the sustainability data we provide to customers.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and curious, a self-starter who enjoys understanding how calculations work, validating assumptions, and ensuring that outputs are reliable and defensible. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys balancing deep independent work with highly collaborative cross-functional stakeholder engagement.

What You'll Do


Work directly with large, complex sustainability datasets to support the development and maintenance of Worldly’s impact content.
Conduct content quality assurance (QA) and user acceptance testing (UAT) for sustainability calculations, metrics, and related content to ensure product and data accuracy and consistency across the Worldly platform.
Update and maintain complex assessment-defining files based on specifications from stakeholders.
Manage analytical content that controls and governs customer data exports.
Investigate and resolve data issues and questions by tracing outputs back to the source data and underlying logic.
Query Worldly data with SQL to support internal and external customer needs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to align data outputs that meet platform needs and customer expectations.
Continuously improve automation, documentation, and internal understanding of calculations, metrics, and data structures.
Conduct targeted research projects.


We'd Like to See


Exceptional attention to detail and a strong desire to understand how data and calculations work from end-to-end.
Bachelor's degree or similar experience in a relevant field (e.g., Sustainability, Environmental Engineering, Data Science).
2+ years of experience working in an analytical, data-focused, or consulting role.
Strong proficiency in SQL and comfort working directly with raw data.
Solid understanding of sustainability concepts, such as environmental impact measurement or carbon accounting.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and move work forward with minimal oversight.
Strong problem-solving skills and persistence when working through complex or ambiguous data challenges.
Clear written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort working cross-functionally and incorporating feedback from multiple stakeholders.
Claude/AI fluency


It Helps If You Have


Experience with Python for data analysis or validation.
Comfort vibecoding your own non-production solutions to analytical and automation problems.
Background in statistics or quantitative analysis.
Familiarity with sustainability reporting frameworks or standards.
Experience working with customer-facing data products or platforms.


What We Can Offer You


Comprehensive benefits offerings - 90% employee premium and 75% spouse/dependent premium are covered by Worldly
Company-sponsored 401(k) with up to 4% match for US-based employees
Incentive Stock Options
100% Parental Paid Leave
Unlimited PTO
13 company holidays


Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

Our team represents over 15 countries and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.

Benefits and Perks


Earn a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Get healthcare, retirement matching, and equity for US employees.
Use our work-from-home stipends to get the supplies you need.
Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge. Our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves.
We're remote, not lonely. Join the culture committee, coffee chats, or a variety of other interest groups.


Travel Notice

This role may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events.

Equity Statement

We believe it's essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We're dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

Compensation


Annual Base Salary: $ 75,000 - $90,000
5% Annual Bonus Potential
Incentive Stock Option Package
Work-From-Home Stipends
Final compensation figures will be determined based on a wide variety of factors, including experience and location. These factors will be evaluated and considered by Worldly throughout the entirety of this process.


Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

Title: Data/ BI Analyst
Description:
Fire Creek Services Company, an All Native Group company, is seeking a Data / BI Analyst to build performance dashboards and monthly performance reports for facility maintenance operations (resolution time, first-time fix, emergency response, preventive maintenance compliance, parts fill rate, data completeness and customer satisfaction), along with failure and lifecycle analyses that guide improvement. This is an immediate opening.

Essential Functions


Define performance baselines, calculation rules and exclusions with the Government customer, and report by request priority, asset class and zone.
Build and maintain operational dashboards that show source timestamps and data sync status.
Produce monthly performance and cost-avoidance reports.
Analyze failure codes and repeat visits, and support parts-demand planning using historical work-request data.
Validate data for accuracy, completeness and timeliness before publishing reports.
Document metric definitions, calculation rules and data sources in a data dictionary.
Protect sensitive data and follow data privacy and controlled unclassified information (CUI) handling practices.


Competencies


SQL and data analysis
Dashboard design and data visualization
Maintenance performance metrics
Explaining data quality issues to operations staff
Data validation and documentation


Supervisory Responsibility

None required for this position

Work Environment

Remote or office-based, computer-focused work, with periodic on-site travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky.

Physical Demands

Title: Data Scientist, Handshake AI
Description:
About Handshake AI

Handshake AI is the fastest-growing, most critical, and most revenue-generating part of Handshake's business. We power expert-labeled data collection at scale, matching domain experts with leading AI companies to train frontier models—and we're already a top-three player in one of the fastest-growing sectors in AI: human data. We have the opportunity to do for the AI data economy what LinkedIn did for professional networking: become the default platform where the work happens.

Why Join Handshake Now


Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
Work hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions
Join a team with leadership from Scale AI, Meta, xAI, Notion, Coinbase, and Palantir, among others
Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue


About The Role

We’re looking for a highly motivated Data Scientist with strong SQL expertise to support analytics, measurement, and operational insights across our human data training workflows. You’ll work with messy, fast-moving data related to expert performance, task quality, throughput, and overall operational efficiency.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership, close partnership with product and operations, and a steep growth curve for someone who executes well.

What You’ll Do


Write advanced SQL to analyze large, complex datasets related to expert performance, task quality, and operational workflows.
Define, build, and maintain core metrics that measure data quality, throughput, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Partner with Product, Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to answer high-impact business and product questions.
Conduct analyses that inform workflow design, task improvements, and operational decision-making.
Build dashboards, reporting, and self-serve analytics that enable fast, informed decisions.
Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and quality issues, then partner with relevant teams to resolve them.
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analyses and actionable recommendations.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Desired Capabilities


3–5 years of experience in Data Science, Product Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Expert-level SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
Strong analytical judgment and comfort working with imperfect, real-world data.
Experience defining metrics and using data to influence product or business decisions.
High ownership mindset and ability to independently drive complex work forward.
Strong communication skills and comfort partnering cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.


Extra Credit


Python experience for data analysis, such as pandas and notebooks.
Experience supporting operational, marketplace, quality, or workforce-related analytics.
Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or metrics-driven product development.
Exposure to AI data workflows, data labeling, or evaluation processes.
Experience with analytics engineering, including building and maintaining DBT models.


Perks


Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life.


The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, wellness stipend

📚 Growth: Learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.

Compensation Range: $135K - $180K

Title: Sr. Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.

Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.

This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.

Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities


Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement
Define the marketing data model: the sources, metrics, and models the work depends on. Build them in dbt where you can, and partner with our analytics engineer on ingestion and the heavier platform work
Build reporting that marketers can run on their own for campaign and channel performance
Partner with marketing leadership in their planning and budget cycles, and take on work outside marketing when the business needs it


About You

Even if you don’t have experience with the specific technologies in our stack, we’d love to talk to you!


5+ years in analytics, including owning a business domain and the stakeholder relationships in it
Deep marketing analytics experience: channel performance across paid and organic, the funnel from lead through closed-won, and the unit economics on top of it
Has built or replaced an attribution model, and can explain where it breaks down
Experience designing and reading out incrementality tests, whether geo, holdout, or comparable, including the statistical work in Python or R
Designs the comparisons and controls a finding needs, and states plainly what the data does and does not support
Strong SQL, and builds reporting in Looker or a comparable BI tool that non-analysts use on their own. Comfortable building and extending models in dbt, or able to pick it up quickly
Works directly with executives, including reframing a request that will not answer the underlying question


Working Style


Values diversity and fosters inclusion on a team with a wide range of identities and experiences
Partners with the teams they support on what the right question is, rather than taking the request as given
Drives to find new tools and ways of working, and spreads them to uplevel the team and the partners they work with
Takes pride in end-to-end ownership. Cares that the numbers are trusted and used, with a point of view about where the domain should go


Nice-to-Haves


Media mix modeling or other top-down measurement experience
Marketo and Marketo Measure, or comparable marketing automation and attribution tools
Salesforce, including campaign influence reporting
Ad platform APIs, PartnerStack, GA, or other spend and engagement sources
Brand or offline measurement experience
ABM account funnel work
Production dbt experience
B2B SaaS with both sales-led and self-serve motions
Fintech, accounting software, or professional services background


About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

Why Pilot?


We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers
The opportunity to join a seasoned founding team that has led companies through two prior successful startups and acquisitions (by Oracle and Dropbox).
Flexible vacation/time-off policy
All federal holidays are observed
Competitive benefits package including additional wellness benefits
Parental leave for birthing or non-birthing parents – 100% pay for 12 weeks
401(k) plan

Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition to cash pay, full-time regular positions are eligible for equity, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time or temporary positions.

Data Analysis Manager — Global Employee Relations Strategy and Operations Team Grade 10

Location: US Remote

This is a hybrid role—a mix of in-office collaboration and remote flexibility.

Who We Are

This role sits on the Global ER Strategy and Operations team—the group that enables the broader Employee Relations organization to do its best work. We build the reporting, insights, and operational backbone behind ER’s work supporting employees and managers. By turning that work into clear data and insights, we help the business understand outcomes and partner more broadly to shape proactive solutions that strengthen the workplace over time.

What You'll Do


Turn complex data into clear answers by analyzing structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights, then shape findings into reports, dashboards, and executive-ready materials.
Recommend, don’t just report: weigh options and tradeoffs, apply analytical thinking and statistical methods where appropriate, and provide clear recommendations informed by the data.
Evolve how we report by enhancing and scaling ER’s existing reporting frameworks, metrics, dashboards, and visualizations to improve insight quality, usability, and impact.
Build meaningful data models and reporting solutions.
Collaborate across teams to build a broader strategy by partnering with Leader Consulting, Legal, and Crisis organizations to define reporting needs, align technical requirements, and move from siloed reporting toward one connected narrative.
Use data visualization and storytelling techniques to communicate trends and business insights clearly to leadership audiences.
Use AI responsibly by leveraging AI tools to support analytics and reporting while maintaining strict adherence to ER data privacy, confidentiality, and security standards.


Who You Are


You have 5+ years of experience in data analysis, people analytics, project management, business intelligence, or a related field, with the ability to distill complex findings into concise, actionable insights for leadership audiences.
Experienced in performing statistical analysis, trend analysis, and data interpretation to support business decision-making.
Fluent in AI, Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau, Airtable, and similar analytics and visualization platforms.
Skilled at translating business questions into analytical approaches.
Proficient in working with both structured and unstructured data, identifying meaningful patterns even when information is incomplete.
Provide recommendations that guide strategic and operational decisions beyond surface-level findings.
Collaborative team player who contributes ideas, challenges assumptions, and offers different perspectives while working toward shared outcomes.
Proactive and accountable, able to execute with quality and urgency even when priorities compete.
Open to emerging technologies and committed to continuous learning.

Experience working with both structured and unstructured data.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

Hippocratic AI is looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to shape product strategy and measure the clinical, operational, and financial impact of our healthcare AI products. This isn't a dashboarding role — you'll help define what "good" looks like for AI clinical agents (including critic frameworks and quality criteria), not just track adoption of a finished product.

You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, clinical teams, and leadership to answer questions like: What should we build? What's driving or limiting adoption? What outcomes are we creating for patients and customers? Where should we invest next — and how do we prove it with data?

The ideal candidate moves comfortably from an ambiguous business question to structured analysis to an executive-ready recommendation, and has the business judgment to know which questions matter most.

What You'll Do

Define how we measure success


Partner with clinical and product teams to define AI agent performance criteria, including critic frameworks and quality metrics.
Define north star metrics and measurement frameworks that guide product strategy — not just measure what already exists.
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact, including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Conduct pre- and post-launch analysis to determine whether initiatives achieved their intended outcomes.


Turn data into decisions and dollars


Translate ambiguous product and business questions into structured analysis and clear recommendations that influence roadmap and prioritization.
Build business cases and ROI models connecting product usage to operational efficiency, cost reduction, capacity, and patient/customer outcomes.
Partner with technical teams to improve instrumentation so the data behind these decisions is reliable.


Represent the work — internally and with customers


Present findings and recommendations (not just metrics) to Product leadership and executives.
Sit directly in customer and partner conversations to represent product data, outcomes, and ROI — this isn't just internal deck prep.
Serve as a strategic analytics partner across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and GTM, and help raise the analytical bar as we scale.


Location Requirement

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.

What You Bring

Must-have


5+ years in product analytics, product strategy, data analytics, business strategy, or management consulting.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline (Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, CS, Engineering, or related).
Advanced SQL and demonstrated ability to independently analyze large, complex datasets; working Python proficiency preferred.
Demonstrated experience using data to influence product strategy, prioritization, or roadmap decisions.
Experience with product analytics/BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, or similar).
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact — including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Experience building business cases, ROI analyses, or financial models, and presenting them to senior stakeholders.


Nice-to-Have


Experience in product analytics or strategy at a technology, healthcare technology, SaaS, or AI company.
Experience working with healthcare data, products, clinical workflows, or healthcare organizations.
Fluency in healthcare financial and value-based care concepts (e.g., HRRP/readmission economics, value-based care arrangements, risk-based contracting).
Experience designing causal, cohort, funnel, retention, or behavioral analyses, especially where RCTs aren't feasible.
Experience presenting to Director/VP/C-suite or senior customer stakeholders.
Experience with AI, machine learning, or LLM-powered products.
Startup or high-growth experience where responsibilities extend beyond a narrowly defined analytics function.


What Success Looks Like

Success here isn't how many dashboards you build — it's whether your analysis changes a decision. You'll help us understand which product investments matter most, which capabilities create measurable value, and how to prove it with data.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors. We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @hippocraticai.com email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.
