Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer-scale transistors to micron-level die-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient.

Job Summary & Responsibilities

We are looking for a highly skilled Data Analyst with deep experience in data modeling, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Oracle ERP (R12 and/or Fusion) data structures. This role is critical for building enterprise‑grade analytics solutions, scalable data models, and integrated reporting frameworks that support strategic decision‑making across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain enterprise‑level data models to support analytics, reporting, and integration needs.
Build high‑quality dashboards, semantic models, and datasets using Microsoft Power BI.
Leverage Microsoft Fabric capabilities—including Lakehouse, Dataflows Gen2, Pipelines, Semantic Models, and Notebooks—to build scalable modern analytics solutions.
Develop DAX measures, Power Query transformations, and dataflows to create governed, reusable data assets.
Understand and interpret Oracle E‑Business Suite (R12) and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP data structures, tables, and reporting layers.
Translate business processes from Finance, Supply Chain, and other functions into robust analytical data models.
Partner with cross‑functional stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, and data logic.
Ensure high levels of data quality, integrity, and governance across Fabric and Power BI assets.
Optimize SQL queries, ETL logic, and BI models for performance and scalability.
Support ad‑hoc analytics and resolve data issues as they arise.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
7–10+ years of experience in data analytics and data modeling.
Strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI (DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, dashboard design).
Hands‑on experience working with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Engineering, Data Factory, OneLake).
Solid SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
Deep practical experience designing data models with Oracle ERP R12 and/or Oracle Fusion will be highly desirable skill.
Understanding data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and star schema design.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.


Why Join Onto Innovation?

At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized.

Compensation & Growth


Base Salary Range:


$104,000.00 - $156,000.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.


Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long-term incentives tied to both company and individual success.


Empowering Every Voice To Shape The Future

Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential - without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team.

Experience with operational or real-time reporting environments.

Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to translate data into business impact.

Highly analytical with a strong problem-solving mindset.
Self-driven and able to operate in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan

Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0250817

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience working in data analysis
Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas or ETL processes
Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with R
Experience with SQL
Experience with HR data and training development
Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
Knowledge of the military or Intelligence Community
Possession of excellent communication skills



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team. The Data Analyst is a key contributor to the product development of Sentia’s agentic behavioral health platform, utilizing a strong data-driven approach. This role involves seamlessly collaborating with various technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate data insights into actionable strategies and communicating the underlying data narrative to non-technical audiences. This analyst will be crucial in the initial setup and architecture of the data warehouse, establishing the foundation for all data operations.

Key responsibilities include collecting requirements, querying databases, and developing dashboards and reports for both internal business stakeholders and external partners. The analyst excels in both qualitative and quantitative data analysis, identifying trends and surfacing crucial insights that lead to informed decision-making, and also excels in consumer product analysis.To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based in Eastern Hours. Talkspace Headquarters in NYC.

What You’ll Do


Data Visualization and Reporting
Develop and refine data visualizations that clearly communicate outcomes, network performance, and user engagement trends to stakeholders.
Create automated quality reports and network performance dashboards using Looker and other tools.
Deeply understand and analyze user pathways, business outcomes, and the dynamics of our provider/partner network.
Quantitative Analysis
Conduct thorough quantitative analyses to support business strategies.
Utilize your expertise in SQL and Python to manage business and provider data effectively.
Strategic Insights
Collaborate with business, finance, marketing and cross-functional teams to provide data-driven insights supporting product development and provider network operations.
Navigate the intricacies of a multi-sided marketplace, understanding different stakeholder needs and market drivers.
Communication and Collaboration
Engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to transform complex data insights into understandable and actionable strategies for enhancing customer service and provider engagement.
Work closely with a seasoned Data Science team to leverage advanced analytics in shaping business and network intelligence strategies.
Create and present easily digestible and actionable recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decision-making processes.
Data Modeling and Pipeline Management Design
Build, and maintain robust, documented, and scalable data models (e.g., using dbt) within the data warehouse to support downstream reporting and analytical needs.
Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize data ingestion processes (ETL/ELT) and ensure the timely availability of high-quality data.
Analyze agentic platform performance metrics
Metrics include model accuracy, latency, conversation depth, and user adherence to behavioral protocols.

About You


3-5 years of experience in an analytical role, experience with healthcare data (patient outcomes, capacity planning, etc.) a plus.
BA/BS in a quantitative field like statistics, applied mathematics, economics, computer science, or equivalent experience.
Proficiency in SQL, python, and Excel / Google Sheets.
Comfortable with statistics and data manipulation.
Advanced skills in data visualization tools like Looker or Tableau are essential.
Experience with product analytics tools like Mixpanel.
Experience with leveraging GenAI tools is a plus.


Benefits


Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage
Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!


Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 and $130,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support


Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.


Program Performance Analytics


Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.


Requirements

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the healthcare industry.
Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.


Personal Attributes


Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.


What Success Looks Like


The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.

Status: Full-time

FLSA: Exempt

Title: Data Analyst (Databricks) REMOTE
Description:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years. 







POSITION SUMMARY




 




The Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing complex healthcare data to generate actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making. This role leverages quantitative analysis, reporting, and data modeling techniques to identify trends, measure performance, and drive process improvements. The Data Analyst collaborates with cross-functional partners to translate business needs into analytical solutions and delivers clear, data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.







THE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE



Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decisions


Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, and analytical models to measure operational and financial performance


Translate analytical findings into clear, concise, and executive-ready summaries and presentations


Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, define requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions


Query and manipulate data using SQL and other tools to extract, transform, and prepare datasets for analysis


Build and maintain structured datasets, including joining tables and validating data integrity


Partner with Operations, Account Management, Product, IT, and Data management teams to align data solutions with business needs


Apply critical thinking to identify root causes of issues and recommend practical, data-backed solutions


Ensure accuracy and reliability of all analyses through thorough validation and quality checks


Document methodologies, assumptions, and processes to support transparency and repeatability


Manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment


Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and alignment


Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance monitoring


Stay current on analytics tools, methodologies, and industry trends to enhance capabilities


Other duties as required









REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS



Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Finance, Business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration or other related field required


5+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or working with relational databases required


3-5 years of experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, or SaaS environment strongly preferred


Familiarity with healthcare terminology (e.g., CPT codes, DRG, claims, inpatient/outpatient)


Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik preferred


Experience with Databricks Data Intelligence Platform


3 years of integrating Databricks, Power BI, and Claude Code


Experience in statistical analysis or predictive modeling techniques


Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and experience writing SQL queries


Timely and regular attendance


Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.









SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES



Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission


Strong ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise


High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, validation, and quality of work


Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities


Demonstrated problem-solving mindset with the ability to independently drive work to completion


Ability to collaborate effectively across teams while also working independently when needed


Ownership mindset with accountability for deliverables and outcomes

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Medix Infusion is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team. This entry-level position is ideal for an individual who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and learning how analytics can support business operations and strategic decision-making.

The Data Analyst will assist with collecting, organizing, analyzing, and presenting data to help teams better understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement. The successful candidate will have foundational technical skills, strong attention to detail, and an eagerness to grow within a collaborative, healthcare-focused environment.

Medix Infusion is a technology-driven healthcare platform dedicated to enhancing patient care and access to infusion therapies. We specialize in disease management and infusion pharmacy services for chronic and acutely ill patients, particularly those in underserved communities. We provide personalized home and in-suite infusion therapies, including anti-infectives, biologics, IVIG, and other injectable treatments, with the goal of making each patient’s journey as smooth as possible.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, organize, and analyze data to support business operations and departmental initiatives.
Assist with developing and maintaining SQL queries for data extraction, validation, and analysis.
Prepare routine and ad hoc reports for business leaders and departmental stakeholders.
Create and maintain dashboards and data visualizations using Power BI.
Assist with cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Review data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and report identified issues.
Work with team members to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into meaningful analyses.
Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Document reporting processes, data definitions, and analytical procedures.
Assist with basic automation and data analysis using Python, Excel, or other available tools.
Participate in testing new reports, dashboards, and data solutions.
Present findings in a clear and understandable manner to technical and non-technical audiences.
Maintain the confidentiality and security of sensitive business, employee, and patient information.
Perform other duties and analytical projects as assigned.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
Foundational knowledge of data analysis, reporting, and visualization concepts.
Basic knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write or modify queries.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filters, pivot tables, and charts.

En Principal creemos que el futuro financiero se construye con decisiones informadas y centradas en las personas. Diseñar dashboards, KPIs y modelos de datos, así como automatizar procesos analíticos y de reportería, entendiendo y aterrizando las necesidades del negocio.

Asegurar la calidad, consistencia y confiabilidad de la información utilizada en las soluciones analíticas.

Licenciatura o ingeniería en Actuaría, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Finanzas, Sistemas, Ciencia de Datos, Negocios o área afín.

Experiencia con Power BI (deseable), SQL, DAX, Power Query y Excel avanzado.
Conocimientos de modelado y transformación de datos, estadística descriptiva e inferencial, pruebas de hipótesis y diseño de experimentos.
R y/o Python deseable, así como conocimientos de Azure, automatización e IA aplicada.

Somos conscientes que un adecuado equilibrio es la mejor forma de tener equipos exitosos y empoderados, por lo cual adoptamos un enfoque de flexibilidad que se adapta a tus necesidades y de tu equipo con base en una cultura de confianza. ¡Flexibilidad! Modalidad de Trabajo híbrido con vestimenta flexible y espacios colaborativos.

Oportunidades y herramientas para impulsar tu desarrollo profesional.
Una comunidad con una cultura de colaboración que prioriza la diversidad, equidad e inclusión y nuestros valores.

We're looking for someone who enjoys getting under the hood of existing reporting, improving what already exists, and building scalable analytics solutions that help leaders make better decisions. As AI continues to accelerate how businesses operate, you'll have the opportunity to combine traditional analytics expertise with modern tools and automation to drive meaningful outcomes.

🌍 Why Pax8?

At Pax8, we're building the managed intelligence marketplace of the future. As our business continues to evolve, data is becoming increasingly central to how we serve partners, improve operations, and unlock growth opportunities.

https://www.pax8.com/en-us/about/

You'll join a collaborative, supportive team that works closely with business leaders across multiple departments while helping modernize the analytics capabilities that power decision-making across the business.

📈 What You'll Be Doing

✨ Transforming complex business questions into clear, actionable insights.

📊 Designing and enhancing dashboards, reports, semantic models, and data products that support both operational and strategic decisions.

🔎 Monitoring key business metrics, identifying trends, uncovering opportunities, and helping stakeholders make data-driven decisions faster.

🛠 Improving existing reporting solutions, simplifying business logic, and reducing complexity across analytics assets.

🏗 Building scalable reporting and data solutions that can grow alongside the business.

🤝 Partnering with leaders and stakeholders across departments to understand challenges and create valuable analytical solutions.

🧠 Conducting investigative analysis and root-cause assessments to uncover drivers behind business performance.

⚙ Supporting modern analytics practices, governance standards, deployment processes, documentation, and quality assurance activities.

🚀 Leveraging AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, documentation, testing, and analytics workflows while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

🌟 The Impact You'll Make

Your work will directly influence how leaders understand performance, priorities initiatives, and make decisions. You'll help create a healthier, more scalable analytics environment while enabling operational teams to move faster with greater confidence.

Success in this role means delivering trusted insights, improving reporting quality, and becoming a valued partner to stakeholders across the business.

🧩 You'll Be a Great Fit If You...


Have substantial experience working in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a similar analytical environment.
Enjoy balancing enhancement work with new solution development.
Are highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working with cloud-based data platforms such as Amazon Redshift.
Have extensive experience building data visualisations, dashboards, semantic models, and reporting solutions using Power BI.
Understand dimensional modelling concepts and are comfortable designing scalable data structures.
Can confidently connect business challenges with analytical solutions.
Enjoy identifying trends, investigating root causes, and translating findings into meaningful recommendations.
Are comfortable presenting insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.
Embrace AI-enabled tools as part of a modern analytics workflow.
Enjoy working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Hold a degree in a relevant analytical, business, technical, or quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Professional certifications relating to Power BI, analytics, cloud technologies, or AI are welcomed but not essential.

Flexible, Open Vacation

Career Development Programs

Employee-led Resource Groups

There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organization. You'll have access to our internal development hub designed to accelerate your skills and stretch your potential. Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We'll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level.

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.

This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.

The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.

Essential Responsibilities


Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.
Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.
Responds to support questions promptly, courteously, and accurately, with an analysis of the results and any issues or changes made with minimal guidance.
Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.
Validates data accuracy and completeness across source systems and downstream reporting layers, identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality issues. Performs quality assurance checks to validate completeness and accuracy of data and/or deliverables for release with minimal guidance.
Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities


Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).


Qualifications / Experience Required


Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.


The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

Omaha & Albany Pay Range $95,000 - $115,000

Chicago Pay Range $103,000 - $133,000

NYC Pay Range $113,000 - $143,000

Please Note

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Titan Technologies, LLC (Titan) is seeking an experienced, self-directed, Senior Data Analyst to support the Special Operations Forces Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) III contract. As a member of our team, you will help to assist USSOCOM, Service Component Commands, Theater Special Operations Commands (TSOC), and deployed forces in the delivery of a full spectrum of Information Technology (IT) services to operate and maintain information flow, communications, and connectivity globally.




The Data Analyst – Senior is responsible for analyzing structured and unstructured data to support decision-making across USSOCOM. This role involves working with data sets from various sources to develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that help leadership and operational teams gain actionable insights. The analyst will collaborate with database administrators, system engineers, and mission stakeholders to deliver high-quality, data-driven visualization solutions in support of SOCOM’s mission.




The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience working with data tools and visualization platforms. This position requires familiarity with databases, data modeling, business intelligence (BI) tools, and basic programming to extract and transform data from multiple environments.




Duties and Responsibilities:

Collect, clean, transform, and analyze large data sets from multiple sources to identify trends and support decision-making.
Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or other BI platforms.
Work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and design user-friendly reports and data visualizations.
Write queries and scripts to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from enterprise databases.
Support the generation of recurring and ad hoc reports for operational and leadership teams.
Contribute to the design and implementation of data models and workflows that enhance reporting efficiency.
Conduct data quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting outputs.
Document data sources, processes, and report specifications for continuity and audit readiness.
Collaborate with IT teams and database administrators to troubleshoot data access and integration issues.
Provide analytical support for strategic initiatives, operational planning, and mission readiness assessments.
Ensure compliance with USSOCOM data governance, classification, and cybersecurity standards.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mentor junior team members by reviewing analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to USSOCOM data governance standards, and fostering technical skill development.




You MUST have:

Education & Experience: High school diploma with a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience, 10 years experience with Associate's, OR 6 years experience with Bachelor's.
Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI clearance or ability to upgrade




Technical Experience

Experience in data modeling, transformation, and visualization.
Familiarity with SQL and experience writing queries for data extraction and analysis.
Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or .NET).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and Access.
Ability to develop data visualizations that inform leadership decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 422 – Data Analyst- Intermediate level or higher (Must have or be able to obtain GSEC, SSCP, CISM, CISSP, GSLC, or CCISO certifications.




It’s GREAT if you also have:

Experience with Microsoft SharePoint integration for data visualization or workflow automation.
Experience with MAVEN platforms
2+ years designing Palantir Foundry workflows: engineering data pipelines, modeling
ontologies, and deploying BI applications to support mission-critical decisions




Education:

High School Diploma with 12 years of experience OR AA + 10 yrs of experience OR BS + 6 years of experience

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

The Analyst II, Data Analysis will be responsible for analyzing complex data sets to derive actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role requires a skilled data analyst with strong analytical abilities, a deep understanding of statistical methods, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in data analysis, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for leveraging data to drive business outcomes.

What You’ll Do


Analyze large and complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
Develop and implement statistical models and algorithms to solve business problems.
Validate and refine models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Create clear and compelling data visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Prepare and present regular reports on data analysis outcomes to senior leadership.
Develop dashboards and other tools to enable self-service data access for business users.
Collect, clean, and preprocess data from various sources to ensure data quality and consistency.
Collaborate with data engineers and IT teams to design and implement data pipelines and workflows.
Ensure data is properly stored, organized, and accessible for analysis.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product, and finance, to support data-driven decision-making.
Provide training and support to team members on data analysis and visualization best practices.
Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analysis.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement innovative solutions.
Attends company training and regional training in area of expertise. Presents own work to members of department.


What You’ll Bring To Zelis


Typically has Bach. +2-3 yrs; Masters +0 yrs
Requires proficiency using AI tools skillfully with an understanding of how to develop/create intelligent prompts and/or agents.
Fluency with data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Excel).
Proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
Healthcare claims editing experience a plus.
Understanding of statistics and data modeling preferred.
Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Experience presenting findings to senior leadership team
Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) is a plus.
Knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Certification in data analysis or related fields.


Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Location and Workplace Flexibility

Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.

While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.

Base Salary Range

$71,000.00 - $90,250.00

At Zelis we are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation packages. The base salary range allows us to make an offer that considers multiple individualized factors, including experience, education, qualifications, as well as job-related and industry-related knowledge and skills, etc. Base pay is just one part of our Total Rewards package, which may also include discretionary bonus plans, commissions, or other incentives depending on the role.

Zelis’ full-time associates are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well-being, and financial protection. The US-based benefits include a 401k plan with employer match, flexible paid time off, holidays, parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the role. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all.

Accessibility Support

We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require a reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email TalentAcquisition@zelis.com.

Disclaimer

All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities, duties, and skills from time to time.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Microsoft Fabric (35903)
Description:
Data Analyst – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.
