Title: Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst
Description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst to provide sustained, hands-on analytical capacity for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. The role develops baselines, recurring metrics, validated calculations, dashboards, data-quality checks, and outcome evidence that help teams understand performance and make informed decisions.

This position follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately 25% onsite presence at LMI’s Tysons headquarters or Washington, DC.

The Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst provides the recurring analytical backbone needed to turn agreed definitions into reliable evidence. The role is responsible for making sure metrics can be reproduced, reconciled, explained, and refreshed consistently rather than producing one-time analyses that are difficult to sustain.

The ideal candidate is detail- oriented but outcome focused. The analyst should be able to move from source data through cleaning, transformation, calculation, visualization, and narrative interpretation while maintaining a clear audit trail of definitions, assumptions, filters, denominators, and known data limitations.

The role depends heavily on stakeholder trust. The analyst should be able to explain why numbers changed, where a discrepancy came from, and what a measure actually represents . Strong candidates will not treat dashboard production as the end goal; they will focus on creating measures that stakeholders can understand and use consistently.

The ideal candidate is a strong execution analyst who can turn messy operational data into clear, traceable metrics and communicate what the numbers do - and do not - support.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities


Prepare, clean, combine, transform, and validate data from multiple sources.
Calculate baselines, recurring metrics, before/after measures, denominators, and outcome indicators.
Build analytical tables, visualizations, dashboards, and decision-ready reporting products.
Document metric definitions, data sources, cadence, validation steps, assumptions, and calculation logic.
Perform data-quality checks, reconcile discrepancies, and maintain reproducible analytical workflows.
Support outcome reports with validated findings, concise narrative, and clear limitations.
Respond to recurring and ad-hoc analytical questions for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Escalate data-quality, access, or methodology concerns that could materially affect conclusions.
Develop and maintain metric dictionaries that define business rules, source fields, exclusions, denominators, refresh cadence, validation steps, owners, and interpretation guidance.
Automate repeatable data-preparation, quality-check, calculation, and reporting steps where practical to reduce manual effort and improve consistency over time.
Reconcile discrepancies across source systems, reports, and stakeholder calculations and document the resolution when definitions or authoritative sources differ.
Support ad-hoc analytical questions by quickly profiling data, testing hypotheses, and translating results into concise findings while preserving reproducibility.
Work with stakeholders to translate reporting needs into precise metric definitions, data requirements, calculation rules, validation checks, and acceptance criteria before building recurring products.
Perform periodic quality reviews of dashboards and recurring reports to identify stale logic, broken refreshes, source changes, unexpected trends, or definition drift that could undermine confidence in the results.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, public health, information systems, business analytics, or a related field.
4+ years in data analysis, reporting, performance measurement, business intelligence, or related work.
Strong SQL plus at least one analytical tool such as Python, R, SAS, or advanced Excel.
Experience with data preparation, validation, dashboards, recurring metrics, and documentation of assumptions/limitations.
Recommended certification: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst or comparable BI/data-analytics credential.
Ability to satisfy VA personnel vetting and applicable security, privacy, records, and data-handling requirements.
Demonstrated ability to build reliable recurring analyses from imperfect operational data, including validation, reconciliation, exception handling, and documentation of assumptions.
Strong practical skills with SQL, Excel and/or Python/R plus a visualization tool, with enough technical depth to trace a metric from dashboard output back to source data and calculation logic.
Clear analytical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain definitions, data-quality concerns, limitations, and changes in results to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience eliciting and documenting reporting requirements, metric definitions, business rules, and acceptance criteria with business or mission stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple recurring and ad-hoc analytical requests, prioritize based on decision need and effort, and communicate realistic timelines when data access or quality is a constraint.


Desired Qualifications


6+ years supporting federal, healthcare, operational, implementation, utilization , or outcome measurement.
Experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, SQL Server, Azure data tools, or similar enterprise analytics platforms.
Experience supporting pilot measurement, program evaluation, before/after analysis, or clinical/operational metrics.
Additional SQL, cloud analytics, data visualization, or Lean Six Sigma certification is preferred.
Experience with Power BI semantic models, DAX, Power Query, SQL Server, automated refresh, data quality monitoring, or controlled reporting environments is preferred.
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, data analytics, SQL, or comparable business-intelligence certification is valuable.
Experience supporting executive dashboards, operational performance reviews, benefits measurement, or program-evaluation reporting in a federal or healthcare environment is preferred.
Exposure to governed semantic models, certified datasets, data catalogs, lineage tools, or enterprise reporting standards is beneficial.


Target salary range: $135,000-$160,000

Since 2015, Nevada Behavioral Health Systems (NBH) has been providing mental health and substance abuse services to residents across Nevada. In 2023, we rebranded as NovumHealth with the expansion of our services in Arizona, California, and Utah.

Position: Data Analyst

Location: Las Vegas, NV – Onsite (This role is not eligible for Remote or Hybrid)

The Data Analyst is responsible for leveraging data to uncover actionable insights that drive clinical, operational, and business decisions. Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to translate requests into actionable queries and analytics that inform decisionmaking.
Analyze large datasets, including claims data, to uncover trends, identify risks, and generate insights related to cost, utilization, and quality.

Design and implement frameworks for tracking healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care measures.
Perform data cleaning and validation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of datasets.
Create comprehensive reports that combine storytelling with quantitative insights to drive actionable recommendations.
Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement or cost optimization through data analysis.
Support ad hoc requests for data analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of results.
Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including clinicians, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment of data analytics with organizational goals.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in healthcare analytics.


What you’ll bring:


Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics and statistical modeling.
Familiarity with electronic medical records systems.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI for developing dashboards and visualizations.
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases and preparing datasets for analysis.
Experience with data cleaning and working with large, complex datasets.
Indepth understanding of healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care frameworks.
Exceptional storytelling skills to present data in a meaningful way to diverse stakeholders.
Strong critical thinking and problemsolving abilities to uncover insights and recommend solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex data findings to nontechnical audiences.

Bachelor’s degree Analytics, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.
Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Health Informatics, Public Health or a related field Preferred.
3+ years of experience with healthcare analytics, with a strong focus on clinical and operational data.

Must pass drug screening and background check in order to start employment with NovumHealth.

Experience in Power BI, SQL, R, and other complex data analysis.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise Services
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career.

Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families.

The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

Grade: Professional 308

Pay Range: $75,200.00 - $112,700.00

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for extracting, processing, analyzing, and reporting on data to produce rigorous, actionable insights and research. They establish and maintain strong relationships with peers and leaders across IAR, Data Engineering, Product Management, Finance, EdTech, and Faculty staff. They perform ad hoc analyses, build standard reports and data visualizations, and deliver information and insights through various methods and media that privilege data storytelling and compress time-to-action.

Primary Responsibilities


Drives the documentation of data and analytics needs in projects of high complexity with a student and equity-centered lens, collaborating with peers, cross-functional partners, faculty staff, and leaders.
Translates of user stories into technical requirements.
Answers complex business questions requiring extensive knowledge of the university’s data assets across several domains and departments.
Identifies adequate data sources and data sets to evaluate hypotheses, build forecasts, and support findings of research projects and experiments.
Collaborates with Data Engineering in the development of complex ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
Identifies, investigates, and solves complex data issues, contributing to the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and validity of the university’s data.
Collaborates with Data Engineering and other data & analytics partners to define standards and best practices that increase data quality across the university.
Combines data analysis, visualization, and narrative structures to convey information in compelling ways that instigate deliberate action.
Conveys information effectively to peers, partners, and senior leaders, using a variety of resources and formats (synchronous and asynchronous, verbal and written) such as e-mails, presentations, meetings, and workshops.
Creates and organizes information about processes, projects, operations, data assets, and insights from analyses and research, making it accessible in ways that increase the university’s knowledge and efficiency.
Writes and interprets technical documentation (e.g., Entity-Relationship, Conceptual, Logical, and Physical data models).
Contributes actively to the development of the university’s data management platforms (e.g., data dictionaries, catalogs, etc.).
Supports and accelerates other team members’ development through constructive feedback and sharing of technical and institutional knowledge.
Drives tasks, activities, and small-scale projects with high levels of autonomy, confidence, and collaboration with peers and partners.
Tracks and reports own progress, dependencies, and challenges diligently. Breaks down complex goals into concrete tasks and activities.
Works actively to improve own skills and knowledge through internal and external, formal and informal, structured and unstructured learning. Is a lifelong learner and embodies a growth mindset. Stays abreast of innovative developments in their area of work and plays an active role in deploying them at the university.
Understands and abides by the relevant policies and methods to access, use, transform, store, and delete data in responsible, secure, and compliant ways.
Performs other job-related duties as assigned.


This job description includes a general representation of job requirements rather than a comprehensive inventory of all required responsibilities or work activities. The contents of this document or related job requirements may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities


Advanced SQL proficiency, with experience writing queries and subqueries, modifying data, creating views, and knowledge of different join types, filtering, sorting, aggregation, window functions, common table expressions (CTE), and performance tuning.
Highly proficient and experienced in using tools like Tableau and Power BI to present data and information utilizing charts, graphs, and maps, in ways that make it easy to understand trends, patterns, and outliers.
Ability to interpret and design models that describe how data relate to one another, and to the properties of the real-world entities they represent. Understands conceptual and logical data modeling, and has experience with dimensional models, star schema, and snowflake schema.
Comfortable with common project management methodologies and frameworks (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, SDLC).
Proficient in MS Office suite, including advanced Excel knowledge.
Proficient in flowchart and diagramming tools like Miro, Visio, Lucidchart, and similar applications.
Familiarized with the university’s most relevant KPIs, the drivers that affect them, and plays an active role in their definition and tracking.
Ability to apply sound judgment, systems-thinking, and analytical skills to assess risks, perform root-cause analyses, make recommendations, and drive cross-functional decisions that contribute to the achievement of the university’s objectives.
Ability to perform with a very high level of autonomy, reliability, self-direction, and with a bias for action. Manages conflicting and concurrent activities with minimal need for supervision.


Education

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.




This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.




The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.




Essential Responsibilities:

Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.
Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.
Responds to support questions promptly, courteously, and accurately, with an analysis of the results and any issues or changes made with minimal guidance.
Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.
Validates data accuracy and completeness across source systems and downstream reporting layers, identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality issues. Performs quality assurance checks to validate completeness and accuracy of data and/or deliverables for release with minimal guidance.
Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.




Additional Responsibilities:

Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).




Qualifications / Experience Required:

Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.




Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.




The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.




$113,000 - $143,000

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Required

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Understanding of event-driven systems and streaming data.


Soft Skills


Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to translate data into business impact.

Highly analytical with a strong problem-solving mindset.
Self-driven and able to operate in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Write SQL queries against SQL Server to answer business questions and generate insights for Operations, Finance, Sales, and Business Development.

The Junior Data Analyst will join the Data & Analytics team and support stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Finance, Purchasing, Business Development, and Engineering. The role centers on turning data into clear, reliable answers. That means working with business teams to understand their questions, analyzing data from across the company, keeping reporting accurate, and communicating findings in a way that supports decision-making. The role offers high visibility into company-wide processes. It's highly collaborative and suits someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of their work. This is an entry-level role for recent graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience.

What You Will Do

  • Write SQL queries against SQL Server to answer business questions and generate insights for Operations, Finance, Sales, and Business Development.
  • Use Python to clean, analyze, and automate work with data.
  • Handle ad hoc analysis requests from start to finish: clarify the question, pull and analyze the data, and present a clear answer.
  • Validate data accuracy across reports and source systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
  • Use AI coding assistants and help build AI agents that automate recurring analysis and reporting.
  • Organize and reconcile data in Excel, mapping and merging data from multiple sources.
  • Support finance-related analysis such as inventory, cost, and margin reporting.
  • Monitor Power BI dashboards for data accuracy and refresh issues, escalating to the BI development team as needed.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within datasets and flag them proactively.
  • Prepare data and visuals for internal and external-facing decks and reports.
  • Document data definitions, query logic, and recurring processes.
  • Manage and prioritize requests from multiple teams.

Requirements

We are Seeking People Who:

  • Have a bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related computational or quantitative field.
  • Have up to one year of professional experience. Recent graduates are welcome.
  • Have hands-on experience from a data-related internship or personal projects, with work they can share, such as a GitHub repository or portfolio.
  • Are knowledgeable in SQL and can write queries, including joins and aggregations, to answer business questions.
  • Can write Python code for data analysis, using libraries such as pandas.
  • Understand at least one BI tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Are proficient in Excel.
  • Have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Are eager to learn new tools and technologies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have high attention to detail and are comfortable working with large datasets.
  • Have exposure to Microsoft Fabric through coursework or personal projects, which is a plus.
  • Understand data flows and architecture, which is a plus.
  • Have completed coursework in data analysis, statistics, or business intelligence, which is a plus.
  • Have an interest in the wireless, electronics, distribution, or supply chain industry, which is a plus.

What's In It For You

  • Salary Range: $65,000 to $75,000 per year
  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A supportive and collaborative work environment.
  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
  • A scaling company with great industry professionals.
  • Amazing opportunities to get involved with exciting projects at significant scale with some of the leading global companies.

Work Location / Type:

  • This role is on-site, and the candidate needs to be within commuting distance of Florham Park, NJ.
  • Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Founded in 2001, by two visionary traders, PCS Wireless, affectionately known as “PCS”, is not your average mobile distributor. Led by fearless entrepreneurs, PCS has completely transformed the landscape of the device resell market, both from a business and a consumer perspective.

Today, PCS is a recognized global leader, powering the secondary market. At PCS, we buy and sell mobile devices and products worldwide through partners and programs by breathing new life into old devices effectively extending the device lifecycle up to 5X and beyond. We collaborate with industry giants in consumer electronic manufacturing, wholesalers, big box retailers and small businesses alike, catering to a diverse clientele of more than 1,500 clients. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Mission: Hospital-Quality Care, Everywhere.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

Our Values: The Principles That Guide Us

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.


We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.


We’re hiring a Data Analyst to turn Verse's data into decisions. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you'll partner directly with functional leaders to build the metrics, dashboards, and analyses that drive how the business operates. Not only are you offering the “what,” but also the “why” and the “what now,” translating messy, ambiguous business questions into clear, defensible, self-serve analytical assets.

If you enjoy high ownership, solving open-ended business problems with data, and having direct influence on a mission-driven company’s trajectory, this role is for you.

What You'll Achieve: A Glimpse into Your Contributions


Spearhead end-to-end analytics across business domains.
Understand trends in operational and customer data to influence how teams prioritize their own roadmaps
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Ops, Product, Leadership) to define new metrics, standardize reporting, and surface insights proactively.
Automate recurring reporting and manual data-quality checks using Python and SQL, reducing turnaround time on regular audits and deliverables.
Design and build algorithms/models (e.g., scoring, classification, similarity, or risk-adjustment models) that solve specific business problems, from provider mapping to fraud detection to cost-of-care scoring.


What You'll Bring: The Skills and Experience You’ll Leverage

We believe that diverse experiences and backgrounds lead to better solutions. While we have an idea of what will help someone succeed in this role, we are open to being convinced by your unique story and skills. If you believe you can achieve the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply.

Core Skills & Experience:


3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics engineering, with experience owning reporting and metrics end-to-end.
Strong experience writing SQL and Python for analysis, automation, and lightweight modeling
Experience building and driving adoption of dashboards (Metabase, Looker Tableau, PowerBI, or similar)
Experience developing custom metrics, scoring algorithms, or classification models to solve specific business problems.
Experience performing exploratory analysis with minimal direction on ambiguous, open-ended business questions
Proactive communicator with experience working with stakeholders
Preferred: Experience with dbt modeling.
Preferred: Experience with Snowflake.
Preferred: Familiarity with healthcare or other regulated data (HIPAA compliance).
Preferred: Experience working closely with engineers to triage and resolve issues.


Benefits:


Competitive compensation.
Opportunities for rapid career advancement in a growing company.
100% premium coverage for health insurance.
401(k) with no matching at this time.


This is a hybrid role based in our New York office and will require you to be in the office 4x in a week.

Our Pledge for an Equitable Future

At Verse Medical, our mission is to deliver equitable, hospital-quality care to everyone, regardless of their background or where they live. We can only achieve this if our own team reflects the diversity of the patients we serve. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, where their contributions are valued, and where they can do their best work. We embrace diversity of all kinds: race, gender, age, religion, identity, experience. We are actively working to build a more inclusive and equitable world, starting from within our own walls. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We are also committed to providing a positive and accessible interview experience. If you require any accommodations to participate in our process, please contact us at recruiting@versemedical.com.

Compensation Range: $85K - $130K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Established in 2021, Independence Pet Holdings is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Clarus is a subsidiary of Doubtless, formerly known as Independence Pet Holdings, Inc. Clarus is a pioneering pet health technology company transforming the future of pet healthcare. We develop connected solutions across the pet health landscape, helping veterinary teams and pet owners make more informed care and financial decisions. Together, we are reducing complexity and helping more pets receive the care they need.

Job Summary

Clarus is seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Data Analyst to join the Analytics team. This individual will serve as a strategic analytical partner to Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and teams across the organization to deliver analytical solutions.

The Senior Data Analyst will bring together sales, CRM, customer, campaign, product usage, and engagement data to create reliable forecasts, dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights. The role will help Clarus improve pipeline visibility, commercial performance, customer retention, product adoption, and partner outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role with defined ownership and visibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and high-level business recommendations. They will bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify opportunities without waiting to be asked, and communicate insights in a way that drives action.

Job Location: Remote – USA. Candidates in EST/CST time zones are strongly preferred. US travel required.

Main Responsibilities


Gather reporting requirements and translate business questions into dashboards, reports, datasets, queries, metrics, and analytical models.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Zoho Analytics, or similar platforms.
Create reusable datasets, SQL queries, and data models that improve consistency and reduce manual reporting.
Establish and document KPI definitions, calculation logic, reporting assumptions, and data sources.
Design reporting assets that are accurate, intuitive, scalable, and appropriate for both operational and executive audiences.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, and leadership to define analytical needs and improve decision-making.
Balance recurring reporting responsibilities with ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
Evaluate lead management performance, including lead sources, routing, follow-up activity, aging, conversion, and pipeline leakage.
Monitor sales activity, account performance, customer engagement, revenue trends, renewals, expansion, and churn.
Analyze Sales performance drivers, growth trends, and areas of underperformance across accounts, customer segments, cohorts, channels, and external partners.
Build and maintain customer health scoring methodologies, including risk signals, adoption indicators, monitoring engagement behavior, and recommended calls to action.
Analyze the customer lifecycle across acquisition, activation, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, expansion, and churn.
Analyze user activity and product engagement to support Product decisions, Customer Success planning, and customer or partner reporting.
Develop customer performance scorecards for account reviews, renewal planning, and internal and external QBRs.
Analyze marketing campaign performance, including reach, engagement, lead quality, conversion, cohort performance, attribution, and downstream pipeline impact.
Prepare executive-ready summaries, presentations, scorecards, and reporting packages for leadership meetings, QBRs, partner reviews, and planning sessions.
Proactively identify gaps in data quality, reporting visibility, customer segmentation, and metric definitions.
Drive adoption of dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and reporting processes through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or higher in analytics, business, economics, statistics, finance, information systems, marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A strong record of success in sales analytics, revenue analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role.
5+ years of relevant experience is preferred; with demonstrated industry knowledge, analytical ability, initiative, and business impact.
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Experience building business dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Zoho Analytics or another CRM-connected analytics platform.
Experience analyzing CRM data, sales pipelines, funnels, customer activity, and commercial performance.
Strong understanding of forecasting, segmentation, conversion, retention, renewal, churn, and customer lifecycle metrics.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear analytical deliverables.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

We’re looking for a top-tier analytics professional to deliver insights that drive growth. As a Senior Data Analyst at Clair, you’ll join a growing team of data practitioners who are passionate about bringing financial security to underserved communities by giving workers access to their earnings right when they need them. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality


Qualifications


4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on


Things We Consider a Plus


Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau
Experience with a scripting language like Python or R
Interest in financial systems and consumer behavior
Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
Experience in a high-growth start-up environment


Additional Details

Location: This is a hybrid position based out of New York City, you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays) with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this role is $150,000-$160,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills and experience and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package which includes equity, benefits and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Clair will only contact candidates from @getclair.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you happen to receive anything suspicious, please ignore it.

Need more convincing?

Benefits

Apart from getting to work with our incredible team, here are some of the benefits you can expect when you join Clair:


Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with option to extend to your family
Fully-paid parental leave
Company-sponsored 401k, HSA, and FSA
Unlimited vacation for salaried roles, generous PTO for hourly roles
Work from home setup allowance
Access to your earnings every day on Clair
Company-sponsored short-term and long-term disability insurance


Equal Opportunity Employer Information

Clair is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For questions, please email us at careers@getclair.com

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities


Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support
Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures
Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained
Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation
Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization
Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate
Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic
Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles
Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage
Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant
Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams
Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary
Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets
Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone
Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components
Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data


Job Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Qualifications


2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role
Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued
Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources
Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping
Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work
Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls
Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence
Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance


Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As


Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Tableau Certified Data Analyst
Tableau Desktop Specialist certification
Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools
Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation
Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases
Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts
Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift
Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices
Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview
Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods


The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
At SimPL Freight Solutions, we simplify transportation for companies that move a lot of freight but don’t want the headache of managing it all themselves. We step in as their transportation team - coordinating shipments, managing carrier relationships, tracking performance, and improving how everything runs behind the scenes.

Our customers range from large manufacturers to high-volume distributors across industries like automotive, building materials, food, and packaging. No matter the industry, the goal is the same: keep freight moving smoothly, efficiently, and without surprises.

We pride ourselves on being proactive, responsive, and accountable - anticipating issues, communicating clearly, and continuously finding better ways to deliver results.

Position Overview

Are you naturally curious, comfortable working with numbers, and always asking why? SimPL Freight Solutions is looking for a Junior Data Analyst who is excited to turn data into meaningful business insights.

This is an early-career opportunity designed for a recent graduate or someone beginning their analytics career. You will join a growing analytics department within a fast-growing logistics company, where your work will support real decisions involving clients, pricing, operations, and company strategy.

You will not be expected to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with strong analytical foundations, attention to detail, and the drive to learn. You will receive guidance from experienced team members while gradually taking ownership of dashboards, reports, models, and improvement projects.

What You'll Do


Collect, clean, and validate client, prospect, pricing, and operational data

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0250817

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience working in data analysis
Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas or ETL processes
Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with R
Experience with SQL
Experience with HR data and training development
Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
Knowledge of the military or Intelligence Community
Possession of excellent communication skills



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
