Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques
Concevoir et fournir des rapports, des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et des visualisations, en garantissant l'intégrité des données provenant de multiples sources
Extraire, compiler et agréger des données issues de multiples sources afin de les présenter sous un format simple et intuitif, qui sera utilisé dans les rapports et les présentations
Compiler les exigences relatives aux rapports récurrents en vue de leur automatisation dans Power BI et participer à leur test une fois développés
Élaborer et exécuter des plans de test, résoudre les problèmes et améliorer en continu les rapports et tableaux de bord BI
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes techniques internes (par exemple, Digital Information) pour garantir la livraison en temps voulu des modèles de données, une communication claire et la résolution des obstacles
Contribuer à la production de rapports ponctuels et ad hoc basés sur des données provenant de différentes sources
Travailler en collaboration avec différents services pour garantir l'exactitude des rapports
Travailler simultanément sur plusieurs initiatives et hiérarchiser les tâches en fonction des livrables à venir

Ce poste exige un grand souci du détail, la capacité à synthétiser des informations et à les présenter sous une forme simple et claire, tant au niveau de la mise en page que de la présentation, tout en sachant les communiquer de manière claire et concise.



Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, finance ou gestion d'entreprise avec une formation en analyse opérationnelle, ou expérience équivalente
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente
Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du reporting ou de l'analyse
Excellentes compétences analytiques et de présentation
Solides compétences organisationnelles
Bonnes compétences en gestion du temps et en hiérarchisation des priorités
Orientation client
Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais stricts
Motivation à travailler dans un environnement dynamique
Capacité à travailler aussi bien en équipe qu'en autonomie
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite des interactions avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)



Votre expertise technique :

Connaissances avancées de Power BI Desktop et intermédiaires de Power BI Service
Maîtrise approfondie du langage DAX (Data Analytics Expressions)
Expérience en extraction et manipulation de données à l'aide de requêtes SQL, de la fonction « Recherche avancée » de CRM et des rapports Power BI existants
Bonne maîtrise des concepts liés aux bases de données et au stockage de données
Connaissances avancées de la suite Microsoft (Word, Excel et PowerPoint)
La connaissance des systèmes CRM et Finance & Operations (MS Dynamics 365) est un atout



Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être



Si vous souhaitez savoir à quoi ressemble l'environnement de travail chez Genetec, voici le lien vers notre vidéo d'entreprise: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA



Nous savons que la diversité des parcours et des expériences apporte une grande valeur à nos équipes. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases nous vous encourageons à postuler - votre profil pourrait nous surprendre!



Merci pour votre candidature, mais veuillez noter que seul(e)s les candidat(e)s sélectionné(e)s seront contacté(e)s. Les chasseurs de têtes et les agences de recrutement ne sont pas autorisés à soumettre des CV par l'intermédiaire de ce site web ou directement aux gestionnaires.

Job Overview:

Genetec is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst for its Customer Experience (CX) organization. We are seeking a dynamic and responsive individual who can thrive in a fast-paced and lively environment and transform complex data into actionable insights. 

In this role, the candidate will support the CX Shared Services (CXSS) team as a key contributor to the entire lifecycle of reporting and analytics efforts—from gathering requirements and extracting data to creating and delivering automated reports. This role will help Genetec's CX organization distinguish itself by providing its team members with detailed metrics, in-depth and accurate data analysis and calculations, and clear presentations that drive decision-making. These reports, analyses, and presentations will be closely related to the performance of our CX operations, with data sourced from databases across different systems (CRM, ERP, Web Portal, IVR, Chat, etc.). This role requires strong skills in data integration, validation, and interpretation. 



Your day at a glance:

Gather requirements for analysis, reports, and presentations from various stakeholders within the CX organization and translate them into technical specifications
Design and deliver reports, KPIs, and visualizations, ensuring data integrity across multiple sources
Extract, compile, and aggregate data from multiple data sources to be presented in an easy and intuitive format, which will be displayed in reports and presentations
Compile the requirements of recurring reports for their automation in Power BI and assist with their testing once developed
Develop and execute test plans, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve BI reports and dashboards
Collaborate with stakeholders and internal technical teams (e.g., Digital Information) to ensure timely delivery of data models, clear communication, and resolution of blockers
Support the generation of timely and ad-hoc reports based on data from different sources
Work in collaboration with different departments to ensure accuracy of the reports
Work on multiple initiatives at once and prioritize tasks according to the upcoming deliverables

This position requires great attention to detail, the ability to harmonize information and transform it into a simple and easy-to-understand format in terms of both layout and presentation, while also being able to communicate it clearly and concisely. 



What makes you a great fit:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, or Business with an operational analysis background, or equivalent experience  
5+ years of relevant working experience  
3+ years of experience working in reporting or analytics  
Excellent analytical and presentation skills 
Strong organizational skills 
Possess good time management and prioritization skills 
Customer-oriented  
Be able to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines  
Motivated to work in a fast-paced environment  
Be able to work in a team environment as well as independently  
Fluent in French and English, both verbal and written



Your technical expertise:

 Advanced Power BI Desktop and intermediate Power BI Service knowledge 
Strong proficiency in DAX (Data Analytics Expressions) 
Experience with data extraction and manipulation with the use of SQL queries, CRM Advanced Find, and existing Power BI reports 
Familiar with database and data warehousing concepts 
Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft suite (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) 
Knowledge of CRM and Finance & Operations systems (MS Dynamics 365) is an asset 



Let's talk perks!

Attractive compensation package
Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule
Subsidized meals in our amazing Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Free, unlimited coffee and fruits
Private, free parking for all employees
Onsite fitness facility with personal trainer, and multiple wellness and health workshops



If you'd like to see what the work environment at Genetec looks like, check out our corporate video: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA



We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!



Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.

Description:
At Wilson Elser, we are redefining what it means to work at a national law firm. With more than 1,400 attorneys across 46 offices nationwide, we are recognized among the top 100 law firms by The American Lawyer and ranked #30 in the National Law Journal’s survey of the nation’s largest law firms.

Our continued success is built on a culture of collaboration, innovation, client service, and mutual respect. We are committed to fostering an environment where employees are empowered to grow their careers, contribute meaningfully, and thrive professionally.

 

Summary

Data Analyst opportunity focused on turning raw data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will collect, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, uncover trends and patterns and present your findings in ways that help leadership make informed business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with proficiency in data visualization tools and excellent communication skills – able to make complex data clear and actionable in support of the business.


Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI,
Tableau, or Excel.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and provide
actionable insights.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular performance reports.
Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements to data collection and management
processes.
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning through data analysis.


Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics or related field.
1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.
Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing databases.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence tools.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Compensation Range: $175K - $210K

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Role: Sr Data Analyst

Location: Omaha, NE (Onsite – 5 days a week)

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead reporting and analytics efforts across operations. This role will focus on building scalable, accurate reporting, identifying insights from operational data, and enabling data-driven decisions across business and technology teams.

Key Responsibilities


Design and build end-to-end reporting solutions, including dashboards, recurring reports, and ad-hoc analysis aligned to business needs.
Partner with stakeholders across Operations, DQAS, OPCC, and Technology teams to define reporting requirements and KPIs.
Develop and maintain data models and pipelines to support reliable reporting.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Own data quality validation and ensure accuracy across reporting outputs.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for leadership.
Drive standardization and automation of reporting processes to reduce manual effort.
Support incident analysis by providing data-backed root cause insights.
Collaborate with engineering teams on data sourcing, transformations, and performance optimization.


Required Skills


Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, performance tuning, and data validation.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Proficiency in data wrangling and analysis using Python or R.
Experience working with large datasets and data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, Hadoop, or similar technologies.
Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and data modeling concepts.
Strong Excel skills for ad-hoc analysis and validation work.
Experience with data quality frameworks and validation techniques.


Preferred Skills


Experience with operational or real-time reporting environments.
Familiarity with railroad, logistics, or transportation data.
Exposure to the Azure data stack, including ADF, Synapse, and Databricks.
Understanding of event-driven systems and streaming data.


Soft Skills


Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to translate data into business impact.
Ability to work across business and technology teams without formal authority.
Highly analytical with a strong problem-solving mindset.
Self-driven and able to operate in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in data analytics or reporting roles.
Proven experience building enterprise-grade reporting solutions.

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Brief Description

About the Role:

The Junior Data Analyst will join the Data & Analytics team and support stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Finance, Purchasing, Business Development, and Engineering. The role centers on turning data into clear, reliable answers. That means working with business teams to understand their questions, analyzing data from across the company, keeping reporting accurate, and communicating findings in a way that supports decision-making. The role offers high visibility into company-wide processes. It's highly collaborative and suits someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of their work. This is an entry-level role for recent graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience.

What You Will Do


Write SQL queries against SQL Server to answer business questions and generate insights for Operations, Finance, Sales, and Business Development.
Use Python to clean, analyze, and automate work with data.
Handle ad hoc analysis requests from start to finish: clarify the question, pull and analyze the data, and present a clear answer.
Validate data accuracy across reports and source systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Use AI coding assistants and help build AI agents that automate recurring analysis and reporting.
Organize and reconcile data in Excel, mapping and merging data from multiple sources.
Support finance-related analysis such as inventory, cost, and margin reporting.
Monitor Power BI dashboards for data accuracy and refresh issues, escalating to the BI development team as needed.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within datasets and flag them proactively.
Prepare data and visuals for internal and external-facing decks and reports.
Document data definitions, query logic, and recurring processes.
Manage and prioritize requests from multiple teams.


Requirements

We are Seeking People Who:


Have a bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related computational or quantitative field.
Have up to one year of professional experience. Recent graduates are welcome.
Have hands-on experience from a data-related internship or personal projects, with work they can share, such as a GitHub repository or portfolio.
Are knowledgeable in SQL and can write queries, including joins and aggregations, to answer business questions.
Can write Python code for data analysis, using libraries such as pandas.
Understand at least one BI tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Are proficient in Excel.
Have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Are eager to learn new tools and technologies in a fast-paced environment.
Have high attention to detail and are comfortable working with large datasets.
Have exposure to Microsoft Fabric through coursework or personal projects, which is a plus.
Understand data flows and architecture, which is a plus.
Have completed coursework in data analysis, statistics, or business intelligence, which is a plus.
Have an interest in the wireless, electronics, distribution, or supply chain industry, which is a plus.


What's In It For You


Salary Range: $65,000 to $75,000 per year
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A supportive and collaborative work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package.
A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
A scaling company with great industry professionals.
Amazing opportunities to get involved with exciting projects at significant scale with some of the leading global companies.


Work Location / Type:


This role is on-site, and the candidate needs to be within commuting distance of Florham Park, NJ.
Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Founded in 2001, by two visionary traders, PCS Wireless, affectionately known as “PCS”, is not your average mobile distributor. Led by fearless entrepreneurs, PCS has completely transformed the landscape of the device resell market, both from a business and a consumer perspective.

Today, PCS is a recognized global leader, powering the secondary market. At PCS, we buy and sell mobile devices and products worldwide through partners and programs by breathing new life into old devices effectively extending the device lifecycle up to 5X and beyond. We collaborate with industry giants in consumer electronic manufacturing, wholesalers, big box retailers and small businesses alike, catering to a diverse clientele of more than 1,500 clients. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0250817

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience working in data analysis
Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas or ETL processes
Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with R
Experience with SQL
Experience with HR data and training development
Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
Knowledge of the military or Intelligence Community
Possession of excellent communication skills



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team. The Data Analyst is a key contributor to the product development of Sentia’s agentic behavioral health platform, utilizing a strong data-driven approach. This role involves seamlessly collaborating with various technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate data insights into actionable strategies and communicating the underlying data narrative to non-technical audiences. This analyst will be crucial in the initial setup and architecture of the data warehouse, establishing the foundation for all data operations.

Key responsibilities include collecting requirements, querying databases, and developing dashboards and reports for both internal business stakeholders and external partners. The analyst excels in both qualitative and quantitative data analysis, identifying trends and surfacing crucial insights that lead to informed decision-making, and also excels in consumer product analysis.To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based in Eastern Hours. Talkspace Headquarters in NYC.

What You’ll Do


Data Visualization and Reporting
Develop and refine data visualizations that clearly communicate outcomes, network performance, and user engagement trends to stakeholders.
Create automated quality reports and network performance dashboards using Looker and other tools.
Deeply understand and analyze user pathways, business outcomes, and the dynamics of our provider/partner network.
Quantitative Analysis
Conduct thorough quantitative analyses to support business strategies.
Utilize your expertise in SQL and Python to manage business and provider data effectively.
Strategic Insights
Collaborate with business, finance, marketing and cross-functional teams to provide data-driven insights supporting product development and provider network operations.
Navigate the intricacies of a multi-sided marketplace, understanding different stakeholder needs and market drivers.
Communication and Collaboration
Engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to transform complex data insights into understandable and actionable strategies for enhancing customer service and provider engagement.
Work closely with a seasoned Data Science team to leverage advanced analytics in shaping business and network intelligence strategies.
Create and present easily digestible and actionable recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decision-making processes.
Data Modeling and Pipeline Management Design
Build, and maintain robust, documented, and scalable data models (e.g., using dbt) within the data warehouse to support downstream reporting and analytical needs.
Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize data ingestion processes (ETL/ELT) and ensure the timely availability of high-quality data.
Analyze agentic platform performance metrics
Metrics include model accuracy, latency, conversation depth, and user adherence to behavioral protocols.

About You


3-5 years of experience in an analytical role, experience with healthcare data (patient outcomes, capacity planning, etc.) a plus.
BA/BS in a quantitative field like statistics, applied mathematics, economics, computer science, or equivalent experience.
Proficiency in SQL, python, and Excel / Google Sheets.
Comfortable with statistics and data manipulation.
Advanced skills in data visualization tools like Looker or Tableau are essential.
Experience with product analytics tools like Mixpanel.
Experience with leveraging GenAI tools is a plus.


Benefits


Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage
Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!


Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 and $130,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Under the supervision of the O&E Program Manager, the Data Analyst will perform duties including data collection, analysis, reporting, outcomes measurement, trend analysis, technical support, program evaluation and quality improvement functions.

Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and findings clearly.
Strong organizational skills, flexibility, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively.
Knowledge of, or the ability to learn and apply, applicable federal and state laws and regulations.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Public Health, Business, Data Analytics, Program Evaluation or a related field, and at least two (2) years of related work experience preferably in conducting data analysis or program evaluation and managing outcomes for community-based programs or social sciences or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Public Health, Business, Data Analytics, Program Evaluation or a related field.
Experience evaluating program outcomes.
Experience using Power BI for data cleaning and transformation.
Familiarity with navigating electronic health record systems.
Knowledge of or practical experience in community behavioral health settings.

Title: Business Intelligence - Health Data Analyst 133-2023
Description:
Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications. The Analyst will work with several databases to pull and integrate data, statistical analysis and data modeling.

Key Responsibilities


Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.
Determine, write and present report results with key findings and trends to appropriate stakeholders.
Complete multiple concurrent ad-hoc analyses, provide corresponding reports based on customer specifications, determine and communicate analytical conclusions and recommendations.
Develop beginner to intermediate level reports and ad-hoc analysis based on specifications outlined by department management. Automate such reports and ensure that they are performed and delivered on schedule.
Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
Perform other job-related duties as assigned.


Qualifications


Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.
Ability to converse and write fluently in English.
Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.


Education/Experience


Bachelor’s degree Required. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred.
Demonstrated use of analytical software. SAS or SQL preferred.
Experience in Power BI, Tableau or similar software preferred.1-2 years of related experience preferred.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Established in 2021, Independence Pet Holdings is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Clarus is a subsidiary of Doubtless, formerly known as Independence Pet Holdings, Inc. Clarus is a pioneering pet health technology company transforming the future of pet healthcare. We develop connected solutions across the pet health landscape, helping veterinary teams and pet owners make more informed care and financial decisions. Together, we are reducing complexity and helping more pets receive the care they need.

Job Summary

Clarus is seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Data Analyst to join the Analytics team. This individual will serve as a strategic analytical partner to Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and teams across the organization to deliver analytical solutions.

The Senior Data Analyst will bring together sales, CRM, customer, campaign, product usage, and engagement data to create reliable forecasts, dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights. The role will help Clarus improve pipeline visibility, commercial performance, customer retention, product adoption, and partner outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role with defined ownership and visibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and high-level business recommendations. They will bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify opportunities without waiting to be asked, and communicate insights in a way that drives action.

Job Location: Remote – USA. Candidates in EST/CST time zones are strongly preferred. US travel required.

Main Responsibilities


Gather reporting requirements and translate business questions into dashboards, reports, datasets, queries, metrics, and analytical models.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Zoho Analytics, or similar platforms.
Create reusable datasets, SQL queries, and data models that improve consistency and reduce manual reporting.
Establish and document KPI definitions, calculation logic, reporting assumptions, and data sources.
Design reporting assets that are accurate, intuitive, scalable, and appropriate for both operational and executive audiences.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, and leadership to define analytical needs and improve decision-making.
Balance recurring reporting responsibilities with ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
Evaluate lead management performance, including lead sources, routing, follow-up activity, aging, conversion, and pipeline leakage.
Monitor sales activity, account performance, customer engagement, revenue trends, renewals, expansion, and churn.
Analyze Sales performance drivers, growth trends, and areas of underperformance across accounts, customer segments, cohorts, channels, and external partners.
Build and maintain customer health scoring methodologies, including risk signals, adoption indicators, monitoring engagement behavior, and recommended calls to action.
Analyze the customer lifecycle across acquisition, activation, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, expansion, and churn.
Analyze user activity and product engagement to support Product decisions, Customer Success planning, and customer or partner reporting.
Develop customer performance scorecards for account reviews, renewal planning, and internal and external QBRs.
Analyze marketing campaign performance, including reach, engagement, lead quality, conversion, cohort performance, attribution, and downstream pipeline impact.
Prepare executive-ready summaries, presentations, scorecards, and reporting packages for leadership meetings, QBRs, partner reviews, and planning sessions.
Proactively identify gaps in data quality, reporting visibility, customer segmentation, and metric definitions.
Drive adoption of dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and reporting processes through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or higher in analytics, business, economics, statistics, finance, information systems, marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A strong record of success in sales analytics, revenue analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role.
5+ years of relevant experience is preferred; with demonstrated industry knowledge, analytical ability, initiative, and business impact.
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Experience building business dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Zoho Analytics or another CRM-connected analytics platform.
Experience analyzing CRM data, sales pipelines, funnels, customer activity, and commercial performance.
Strong understanding of forecasting, segmentation, conversion, retention, renewal, churn, and customer lifecycle metrics.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear analytical deliverables.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting findings to senior leaders and non-technical audiences.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, documentation, and reporting quality.


Preferred Qualifications


Relevant experience in animal health, veterinary services, pet insurance, insurance, SaaS, fintech, health technology, or similar environment highly desired.
Intellectually curious, resourceful, and motivated to understand how the business works.
Takes initiative, identify needs early, and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
Comfortable operating in an evolving, high-growth environment.
Can move easily between hands-on analysis, stakeholder conversations, and executive-level communication.
Able to manage deliverables while continuing to improve the underlying processes.
Able to build trust by producing accurate work, communicating clearly, and following through on commitments.


Compensation


Chicago Base pay range: $100,458 – $125,574 per year
New York Base pay range: $109,509 - $136,990 per year
Nationwide Base pay range: $91,325 - $114,158 per year


This is the range we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Placement within the range depends on job-related factors such as experience, skills, and certifications. This position is not eligible for an annual bonus. Base pay is one part of a total rewards package that includes the benefits listed below.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Overview

Turn raw data into insights that National Guard leaders act on every day. As our BI Analyst on DA2I, you'll build Qlik Sense dashboards and data models that drive decisions at the highest levels of the client organization, with room to work hands-on in Palantir Foundry and shape BI standards across the team. If you're energized by cutting-edge tools and mission-critical impact, we want to hear from you.

FWI is building a team to support the National Guard Bureau's (NGB) Minuteman Community Space and as BI professional, you will play a crucial role in building Qlik Sense data models and dashboard visualization solutions in support of mission-critical work for the National Guard. If you are passionate about leveraging your BI skills, have a curious and analytical mindset, and enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies to enable efficient data analysis, we encourage you to apply.

Work Schedule and Location:

On-Site: This full-time position will work Monday through Friday, in Arlington, VA.

FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025 and 2026 Top Workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment .

Responsibilities


Create data visualizations and dashboards to present insights to end-users, driving improved decision-making for leaders at the highest levels of the client organization
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities, becoming an expert in the data and its applications
Follow and enhance BI standards across the team, including keeping up to date with Qlik Sense product enhancements and best practices
Ensure optimal end-user performance by establishing and consistently executing overall system performance assessment processes and associated action plans
Support the design and development of data models, ensuring data integrity and relevance
Communicate and coordinate with teams to accomplish objectives and deliver excellence
Proactively identify opportunities to drive analysis forward and present actionable insights to National Guard customers


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:


3-10 years of directly related experience and a B.A./B.S. or M.A./M.S. in a related field
Professional dashboard-development experience using business intelligence software such as Qlik Sense, Tableau, or Power BI
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality results
Must possess an active Secret clearance at minimum


Preferred Qualifications


Recent DoW experience
Previous experience with Advana or the War Data Platform
3+ years of experience with Qlik Sense data modeling and building dashboards and data visualizations
3+ years of experience with Qlik Sense, including styling Qlik Sense apps using CSS
Familiarity with database systems, SQL queries, and programming languages such as Python
Experience building within Palantir Foundry applications, including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia


FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.

Why Join Our Team

Benefits

At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. You'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. Join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including:


Health Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Long-term and Short-term Disability Insurance
Life Insurance
401(k) Plan
Holiday Pay
Paid Time Off


Pay Range

$105,000 -$115,000 per year depending on experience, education, and clearance level.

Title: Data Analyst (Databricks) REMOTE
Description:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years. 







POSITION SUMMARY




 




The Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing complex healthcare data to generate actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making. This role leverages quantitative analysis, reporting, and data modeling techniques to identify trends, measure performance, and drive process improvements. The Data Analyst collaborates with cross-functional partners to translate business needs into analytical solutions and delivers clear, data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.







THE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE



Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decisions


Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, and analytical models to measure operational and financial performance


Translate analytical findings into clear, concise, and executive-ready summaries and presentations


Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, define requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions


Query and manipulate data using SQL and other tools to extract, transform, and prepare datasets for analysis


Build and maintain structured datasets, including joining tables and validating data integrity


Partner with Operations, Account Management, Product, IT, and Data management teams to align data solutions with business needs


Apply critical thinking to identify root causes of issues and recommend practical, data-backed solutions


Ensure accuracy and reliability of all analyses through thorough validation and quality checks


Document methodologies, assumptions, and processes to support transparency and repeatability


Manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment


Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and alignment


Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance monitoring


Stay current on analytics tools, methodologies, and industry trends to enhance capabilities


Other duties as required









REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS



Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Finance, Business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration or other related field required


5+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or working with relational databases required


3-5 years of experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, or SaaS environment strongly preferred


Familiarity with healthcare terminology (e.g., CPT codes, DRG, claims, inpatient/outpatient)


Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik preferred


Experience with Databricks Data Intelligence Platform


3 years of integrating Databricks, Power BI, and Claude Code


Experience in statistical analysis or predictive modeling techniques


Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and experience writing SQL queries


Timely and regular attendance


Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.









SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES



Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission


Strong ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise


High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, validation, and quality of work


Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities


Demonstrated problem-solving mindset with the ability to independently drive work to completion


Ability to collaborate effectively across teams while also working independently when needed


Ownership mindset with accountability for deliverables and outcomes

The Statistician/Data Analyst supports the data collection and analysis efforts of a government program and contributes to the ongoing initiatives of a larger team. The ideal candidate will enhance and develop reporting and analytics capabilities, support forecast modeling, develop automated reporting solutions and dashboards, build briefing products, conduct analysis and deliver analytical results, and coordinate/implement data collection efforts.

Position Duties:


Work with domain experts and data analysts to develop reporting products.
Conduct high-level data interpretation and statistical analysis using a data analytics platform.
Prepare written summaries and presentations that reflect the results of data analysis and present findings to agency leadership.
Provide ad-hoc data reporting as needed.
Prototype data products and conduct analysis and feasibility based on program requirements.
Build connections, develop reports, and publish data to both development and production environments.
Create presentations and prepare documentation as needed.
Provide training for data analysts and staff on data tools and products, as well as for contractors and field staff on the use of data collection and analysis tools.
Support data collection, analysis and visualization projects as needed, including data modeling, database creation, and technical support.
Recommend technical and automated solutions for manual processes.
Work with contractor and federal staff to enhance the collection and analysis of program data.
Update and develop data collection tools and processes to yield statistically reliable and informative data and support program assessments.
Assist in identifying performance outcomes and indicators.
Identify uniform data points for analysis.
Assist with projects that support the continual improvement of data analysis.
Compile, analyze, and visualize data using a data visualization platform such as Tableau.


Qualifications:


Requires BS/BA degree in Statistics or a related field as well as 8 years of related experience, or MS/MA degree with 6 years of experience.
Working knowledge of data visualization platforms (Tableau) and scripting languages (R/Python/SAS).
Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with relational databases.
Exceptional analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and strong verbal and written communication skills.
Previous experience working with children or in a health services realm preferred, but not required.
Top candidates will have specialty skills in one or more of the following areas:
Statistical analysis and modeling.
Natural language processing.
Quantitative and qualitative data analysis
Data engineering, to include experience working with large datasets and performing tasks such as data cleaning and processing (ETL).
Fundamental working knowledge of SQL.
Python and/or R.
Tableau.
Palantir.
Data entry.

Additional Requirements: 


This position requires an existing  Public Trust or the ability to obtain one.  
This role and associated duties will be performed on site at a government facility located in Washington, DC.

Your work will directly influence how leaders understand performance, priorities initiatives, and make decisions. You'll help create a healthier, more scalable analytics environment while enabling operational teams to move faster with greater confidence.

Have substantial experience working in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a similar analytical environment.
Enjoy balancing enhancement work with new solution development.

Have extensive experience building data visualisations, dashboards, semantic models, and reporting solutions using Power BI.
Understand dimensional modelling concepts and are comfortable designing scalable data structures.
Can confidently connect business challenges with analytical solutions.
Enjoy identifying trends, investigating root causes, and translating findings into meaningful recommendations.
Are comfortable presenting insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.
Embrace AI-enabled tools as part of a modern analytics workflow.
Enjoy working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Professional certifications relating to Power BI, analytics, cloud technologies, or AI are welcomed but not essential.
