We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.

Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.

Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.

Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.

Job Summary

ProMach is seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Data Analyst to help transform our complex data landscape into actionable business insights. You’ll work with data from multiple ERP, CRM, and operational systems, supporting key business decisions in finance, operations, and supply chain. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on data work, cross-functional collaboration, and building impactful reports and dashboards. Fluency in Italian and English required

Why This Role Matters

As a Data Analyst at ProMach, you’ll play a critical role in shaping business strategy by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data from dozens of systems and databases. Your insights will help drive efficiency, identify opportunities, and support growth across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and analyze data from ERP, CRM, and other business systems to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reports for business users and leadership.
Write SQL queries and use analytics tools to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements.
Present findings and recommendations through clear visualizations and presentations.
Support data migration, integration, and quality initiatives to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Document data processes, definitions, and methodologies for transparency and repeatability.
Stay current with best practices in data analysis, visualization, and reporting.


Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or analytical area, or demonstrated equivalent experience in data analysis or a related field

Experience building dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data kccuracy.
Ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience gathering requirements and working with cross-functional teams.
Deep Knowledge of data flows within ERP/CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Infor LN, Salesforce) in a manufacturing environment
Candidate must be fluent in both Italian and English.


Preferred


Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Delta Lake).
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata documentation.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus.
Exposure to Agile project environments and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Git).

Title: Data Analist / BI Specialist
HTML:
Als Data Analist / BI Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat organisaties hun data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten. Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Daarbij benadrukken wij dat gelijke kansen voor iedereen een belangrijk uitgangspunt zijn in onze selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo bachelor of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;
  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen;
  • Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren met tools zoals PowerBi, Qlik of Tableau;
  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;
  • Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • AI-affiniteit is een pré.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst on our Growth team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing performance to new heights. You will collaborate closely with User Acquisition and Growth partners to analyze data, find opportunities, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will empower strategic business decisions and improve player experiences.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with UA and Growth collaborators to understand performance, investigate business questions, and provide actionable recommendations.
Lead analytical projects end-to-end, from problem definition and data exploration through to insights and collaborator communication.
Own and evolve the business logic and analytical requirements of Growth data models, ensuring they accurately represent how the business measures performance.
Act as a key collaborator with Data Engineering, translating business and analytical needs into clear data requirements and validating delivered solutions.
Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps across Growth reporting and underlying data models.
Build and maintain scalable reporting and analytical solutions, reducing repetitive manual analysis where possible.
Define and maintain key Growth metrics and measurement logic across areas such as spend, acquisition, revenue, attribution, and marketing performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses to understand performance drivers, find opportunities, and support investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators, including senior leadership.
Provide technical mentorship and share standard methodologies with other analysts while contributing to consistent analytical standards across the team.
Work closely with Data Scientists on measurement, experimentation, and modeling projects by offering solid analytical and data foundations.


What We're Looking For

We Are Seeking An Ambitious And Seasoned Senior Data Analyst With a Proven Track Record Of Delivering Outstanding Results. You Should Have


4+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related role.
Strong experience independently delivering analytical projects and working directly with business collaborators.
Experience owning or contributing significantly to analytical data models, metric definitions, or reporting foundations.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience working with large and complex datasets.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation and analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and analytical data structures.
Experience converting business requirements into data requirements and collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
Proficiency in a data visualization/BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.
Good understanding of statistical analysis and experimentation.
Familiarity with digital marketing data, attribution, and acquisition metrics is a strong plus.
A strong ownership approach, comfortable independently driving work through to completion.
A curious and analytical nature, always looking to investigate unexpected results and challenge assumptions.
Realistic and dedicated to identifying ways forward.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast paced business environment.
Strong collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams.
Excellent communication skills, able to challenge constructively and build trust with technical and non-technical collaborators.
Willingness to assist in the technical growth of other analysts and help maintain high analytical standards throughout the team.


Opis stanowiska mógł zostać sprawdzony i udoskonalony przy użyciu narzędzi wykorzystujących sztuczną inteligencję w celu poprawy przejrzystości, spójności i inkluzywności. Ostateczna treść, wymagania dotyczące stanowiska oraz decyzje rekrutacyjne podlegają weryfikacji przez człowieka i zatwierdzeniu przez Aristocrat.

Filozofia wynagradzania

Oferujemy kompleksowy pakiet wynagrodzenia i świadczeń, zaprojektowany tak, aby pozostawać konkurencyjnym na rynku, wspierać dobrostan pracowników oraz doceniać ich wkład w nasz sukces. Nasze podejście opiera się na zasadzie wynagradzania za wyniki, nagradzając indywidualny wpływ i osiągnięcia. Twój indywidualny pakiet wynagrodzenia zostanie określony na podstawie takich czynników jak umiejętności, doświadczenie, kwalifikacje oraz lokalizacja.

W zależności od stanowiska i lokalizacji możesz być uprawniony(-a) do otrzymywania rocznych premii i świadczeń motywacyjnych, benefitów związanych ze zdrowiem i dobrostanem, płatnego czasu wolnego, programów emerytalnych, ochrony ubezpieczeniowej oraz innych lokalnych lub ustawowych świadczeń.

Opis stanowiska mógł zostać sprawdzony i udoskonalony przy użyciu narzędzi wykorzystujących sztuczną inteligencję w celu poprawy przejrzystości, spójności i inkluzywności. Ostateczna treść, wymagania dotyczące stanowiska oraz decyzje rekrutacyjne podlegają weryfikacji przez człowieka i zatwierdzeniu przez Aristocrat.

Filozofia wynagradzania

Oferujemy kompleksowy pakiet wynagrodzenia i świadczeń, zaprojektowany tak, aby pozostawać konkurencyjnym na rynku, wspierać dobrostan pracowników oraz doceniać ich wkład w nasz sukces. Nasze podejście opiera się na zasadzie wynagradzania za wyniki, nagradzając indywidualny wpływ i osiągnięcia. Twój indywidualny pakiet wynagrodzenia zostanie określony na podstawie takich czynników jak umiejętności, doświadczenie, kwalifikacje oraz lokalizacja.

W zależności od stanowiska i lokalizacji możesz być uprawniony(-a) do otrzymywania rocznych premii i świadczeń motywacyjnych, benefitów związanych ze zdrowiem i dobrostanem, płatnego czasu wolnego, programów emerytalnych, ochrony ubezpieczeniowej oraz innych lokalnych lub ustawowych świadczeń.

Szczegółowe informacje dotyczące wynagrodzenia i świadczeń dla tego stanowiska zostaną omówione podczas procesu rekrutacyjnego.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
You will join the Technology & Partnership Reporting team. Our team plays a key role in supporting senior management's day-to-day decision-making by delivering timely, accurate, and insightful reporting on technology initiatives and partner performance. We work closely with internal technology teams and external partners to align on reporting priorities, track performance, and surface insights that drive action, helping shape how Telenet delivers on its technology and partnership strategy.




Your tasks as a Data Analyst

You develop curiosity and a deep understanding of your domain's business context and processes.
You understand the business context and processes underlying business requests and reformulate them into clear insights questions.
You collect, query, clean, validate, and manipulate data from different sources to support reporting and analytical needs.
You define, build, and automate reporting dashboards relevant to the technology and partnership topics you are working on.
You develop a proactive partnership with your stakeholders, anticipating their needs and bringing data-driven recommendations to the table.
You perform deep-dive analyses on specific insights requests that lead to actionable recommendations for business and technology colleagues.
You contribute to optimizing reporting processes, tools, and methodologies, including the handling of ad-hoc business requests
You take an active role in the community of data professionals within Telenet, through sharing sessions, inspiration, and coaching.




Our ideal Data Analyst

You have strong analytical skills.
You have a hands-on mentality to really dive into the data and find the answers.
You have a constructive mindset and can collaborate effectively with colleagues from various teams, both from a business and a more analytical background.
You can manage an analytics initiative end to end, including strong communication & presentation skills and stakeholder management.
You have experience in reporting and a solid understanding of performance measurement.
You have solid knowledge of one of the main dashboard tools (Qlik Sense, Power BI, or Tableau); previous Qlik Sense experience is a strong plus, as it is our primary reporting tool.
You have exceptional knowledge of SQL. Experience with Snowflake is a nice to have.
You have an interest in technology, IT, and operational processes
You have a relevant degree and experience:
Master's degree in a quantitative field (business engineering, TEW, computer science, information management, etc.)
Min. 3 years work experience.
Fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch or French is a bonus.




Our offer to you

At Telenet group, you get more than just an attractive gross salary. We strongly believe in results and ownership: we give trust but also expect commitment and impact. What you achieve truly matters.

In addition to a thirteenth-month salary and holiday pay, you can count on an extensive package of extra benefits that supports you in your daily life as well as at work.




An overview of our benefits:

Mobility budget: compose your own mobility plan, you can opt for a company car or alternative mobility solutions
Meal vouchers and eco vouchers
Mobile phone, mobile subscription, laptop, and employee discounts
Collective bonus and individual bonus (aligned with your performance)
Hospitalization insurance (including an ambulatory plan) and group insurance
20 days of paid leave and 12 compensatory days off

We value your ongoing development, investing in growth via our internal learning platform, coaching, and on-the-job training. You will have opportunities to keep learning and further strengthen yourself in your role.

We also prefer working closely together. We believe strong teams form by frequent interactions and quick transitions. To facilitate a smooth onboarding and rapid integration for new employees, we expect you to be present in the office at least three days a week during the first six months. On other days, you can work remotely from home.

Creación de Dashboards, desarrollos en BD, análisis adhoc.
Comunicación y coordinación constante con las diferentes áreas de Verisure para entender correctamente los datos.


Requisitos Para La Posición


Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años en proyectos de BI en funciones similares.
Titulación universitaria superior: Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
Dominio leguaje SQL y experiencia trabajando en BBDD tales como Oracle, SQL Server, Sybase, Snowflake ).
Experiencia demostrable con Power BI o herramienta de visualización de datos similar
Persona proactiva, analítica y con buena capacidad de comunicación.
Clara Orientación al Cliente.


Valorables


Conocimiento de metodologías Agile
Experiencia previa en Python
Experiencia previa con AWS
Experiencia previa con otras herramientas de Visualización y Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, o de reporting como Business Objects

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!





This job was posted on 02/07/2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.

Responsibilities:

  • Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
  • Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
  • Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
  • Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
  • Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
  • Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
  • 4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
  • University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent English
  • Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights

Additional Information

What do we offer?

  • Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
  • Fast growing international company with stable employment
  • Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
  • Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
  • Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
  • Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
  • Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
  • AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
  • Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
  • Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
  • Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work



The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.

Join us today and let’s create a success story together!

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Descriptif du poste

Dans le cadre de projets de transformation data, nous recherchons un·e Data Analyst capable de transformer les données en informations actionnables pour les équipes métiers et les équipes de pilotage.

Vous interviendrez sur des missions longues, au sein d’environnements structurés, pour analyser, fiabiliser et valoriser les données. Vous contribuerez à la production d’indicateurs, de reportings et de tableaux de bord destinés à accompagner la prise de décision et l’amélioration des parcours, outils et processus internes.

Vos missions


Recueillir, comprendre et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers.
Extraire, nettoyer, contrôler et analyser les données issues de différentes sources.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et reportings décisionnels.
Définir et suivre les KPI nécessaires au pilotage de l’activité.
Produire des analyses ad hoc afin d’identifier des tendances, anomalies, opportunités ou axes d’amélioration.
Participer à la fiabilisation et à la documentation des données et des indicateurs.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, BI, produit et métier.
Restituer les résultats de manière claire, synthétique et adaptée à des interlocuteurs variés.
Contribuer à la diffusion d’une culture data au sein des équipes.


Profil recherché


Formation supérieure en data, statistiques, informatique, école d’ingénieur ou équivalent.
Expérience significative en analyse de données, BI ou pilotage de la performance.
Très bonne maîtrise de SQL et des outils de visualisation de données.
Maîtrise de Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense ou d’un outil équivalent.
Connaissance de Python ou R pour l’analyse et la préparation des données.
Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métier et à les traduire en indicateurs pertinents.
Rigueur, esprit analytique, autonomie et excellentes capacités de communication.
Maîtrise du français ; un anglais professionnel est apprécié.


Les plus


Connaissance de Dataiku pour la préparation, l’analyse ou l’industrialisation des traitements data.
Connaissance de Talend ou d’un outil ETL équivalent.
Expérience sur des données complexes et volumineuses.
Expérience auprès de grands comptes de l’assurance, des mutuelles ou de la protection sociale.
Sensibilité aux enjeux de gouvernance, de confidentialité et de conformité des données.


Déroulement des entretiens


Un premier échange avec Aurélie, à la suite duquel vous saurez tout (ou presque) d’eXalt Ouest,
Un entretien technique avec l’un de nos experts Data
Un entretien final avec le Directeur d’Agence, pour finir de vous convaincre de nous rejoindre 😊


Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and

Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.
You deliver data products rather than one-off reports, reusable models and tools that keep delivering value over time.
You own our semantic layer, the metric definitions, business logic and data models that make sure there is one trusted answer to any business question, for people and for AI.
You own the implementation and evolution of our self-service analytics tools, so internal stakeholders can answer their own recurring questions.
You learn all aspects of the travel industry covering Finance, Product, Sales and Operations perspective, and engage with Business stakeholders to define KPIs, including how data is captured, shared and leveraged across departments.


Your Basic Qualifications


Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work autonomously with high ambiguity, alone or in a team as required
Advanced SQL, Python and strong data modeling fundamentals
Experience defining and maintaining shared metric definitions across an organisation
Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)


We are also interested in


Understanding of AI/ML concepts
Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors


Our offer

📄 Contract type: Permanent

🕓 Working hours: Full-time – 40h/week, from Monday to Friday

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

🌍Multicultural and international team

🙌Collaborative and smart environment to work and learn

🍻Free coffee to kick-start your day and free beers to celebrate together

BizAway avoids any discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, health status, nationality, political opinions, and religious beliefs in all decisions affecting personnel selection.

Title: Data Analyst BI confirmé (H/F)
Description:
Depuis sa création, KLANIK s'est donnée pour mission de conjuguer expertise technologique et authenticité.

Ce pari audacieux, né à Marseille en 2011, en France, s'est transformé en une aventure internationale qui compte aujourd'hui plus de 800 collaborateurs, des implantations dans 10 pays et des filiales innovantes. Nous rejoignons en 2026 le groupe ALTEN, acteur mondial de l'ingénierie et des services numériques.

Notre rôle : recruter les meilleurs talents & les connecter à nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets digitaux. KLANIK est une société de conseil en informatique structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertises : Data & IA, DevOps Cloud Infra, Cybersécurité, Software, Produit Agilité Pilotage.

Nos 800 talents ont des profils variés : tech (nos pôles d'expertises), opérationnels (fonctions commerciales et recrutement) et support.

Au‑delà des métiers, KLANIK cultive un modèle profondément humain, qui dépasse les frontières : de la Belgique à la Colombie, nos valeurs résonnent. Une culture fondée sur le partage, l'exigence et la bienveillance - un collectif où chacun peut trouver sa place. En témoignent nos filiales :

Klanik Esport : club Esport & agence de gamification;

Korner : incubateur de startups tech;

Kampus : organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi

l'Act'In Klanik, rôles qui permettent à nos collaborateurs de faire vivre leurs passions au-delà de leurs missions.

Notre culture est résumée par cette phrase, souvent apposée sous notre logo : Human-Made Technology. La tech oui, mais une tech humaine, qui diffuse un modèle où l'authenticité de chacun est la priorité.

KLANIK, en tant que société à mission, croit en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de genre, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force qui contribue à notre succès.

Le Poste

Rejoignez un acteur majeur du secteur de la banque et contribuez à des projets à fort impact !

Vous avez envie de rejoindre une ESN moderne, avec un business model participatif, tournée vers l'humain et la formation de ses collaborateurs ?

Alors nous avons besoin de vous pour répondre aux différents besoins de nos clients !

Si vous faites le pari de nous rejoindre, vous évoluerez chez différents clients au fil de votre expérience chez Klanik.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Data d'un de nos clients dans le secteur bancaire , nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst BI pour intervenir auprès d'une ou plusieurs équipes produit .

Vous rejoindrez un environnement Data structuré, au sein duquel vous contribuerez directement à la valorisation des données, à la production d'analyses et de tableaux de bord, ainsi qu'à l'accompagnement des métiers dans leurs problématiques décisionnelles.

Vous évoluerez dans un contexte Agile, en étroite collaboration avec les Product Owners, Business Analysts, équipes de développement et interlocuteurs métiers.

L'environnement technique s'articule notamment autour de SQL, MicroStrategy et Teradata.

Vos principales missions

En tant que Data Analyst BI, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :


Collaborer avec les Business Analysts afin de comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) pertinents.
Explorer, analyser et valoriser les données disponibles afin de produire des analyses descriptives, reporting et tableaux de bord BI.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord MicroStrategy, en veillant à leur pertinence fonctionnelle et à leur qualité.
Requêter et extraire les données via des scripts SQL, à des fins d'analyse ou pour répondre à des besoins opérationnels.
Conduire des analyses Data en lien direct avec les problématiques et enjeux métiers.
Présenter les résultats des analyses auprès d'un public métier varié, animer des réunions et faciliter la compréhension des données.
Interpréter les résultats et formuler des insights et recommandations business auprès des parties prenantes.
Accompagner les métiers dans l'application des principes de gouvernance et de protection de la donnée : Data Management, Data Privacy, conformité, etc.
Documenter les analyses, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques ainsi que les guides utilisateurs des tableaux de bord.
Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des livrables existants : évolution des rapports, optimisation des dashboards et amélioration des processus analytiques.
Être force de proposition sur les solutions permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la pertinence et l'efficacité des analyses BI.


Déroulement Des Entretiens

Chez Klanik, nous souhaitons apporter la meilleure expérience candidat possible. Ainsi, nous privilégions les processus de recrutements les plus courts possibles, et encadrés par des valeurs de partage, de bienveillance et d'exigence.

Vous serez amené à échanger tout au long du processus avec :


Nos HR Partner
Nos Validateurs Techniques
Nos Business Managers


Profil

Formation et expérience


Formation supérieure Bac +3 minimum en informatique ou domaine équivalent.
5 ans d'expérience minimum sur un poste équivalent
Expérience significative dans le secteur bancaire


Compétences techniques indispensables


Maîtrise des requêtes et de l'extraction de données pour les besoins d'analyse
Expertise indispensable en SQL.
Maîtrise des environnements de bases de données SQL
Expertise sur un outil de Data Visualisation / Business Intelligence
Une expertise sur Power BI ou Tableau peut également être considérée


Qualités attendues


Excellente communication & pédagogie
Esprit d'équipe
Esprit critique : savoir challenger le besoin métier et proposer des solutions adaptées
Autonomie & adaptabilité

Rejoignez un acteur majeur du secteur de la banque et contribuez à des projets à fort impact !

Vous avez envie de rejoindre une ESN moderne, avec un business model participatif, tournée vers l'humain et la formation de ses collaborateurs ?

Alors nous avons besoin de vous pour répondre aux différents besoins de nos clients !

Si vous faites le pari de nous rejoindre, vous évoluerez chez différents clients au fil de votre expérience chez Klanik.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Data d'un de nos clients dans le secteur bancaire , nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst BI pour intervenir auprès d'une ou plusieurs équipes produit .

Vous rejoindrez un environnement Data structuré, au sein duquel vous contribuerez directement à la valorisation des données, à la production d'analyses et de tableaux de bord, ainsi qu'à l'accompagnement des métiers dans leurs problématiques décisionnelles.

Vous évoluerez dans un contexte Agile, en étroite collaboration avec les Product Owners, Business Analysts, équipes de développement et interlocuteurs métiers.

L'environnement technique s'articule notamment autour de SQL, MicroStrategy et Teradata.

Vos principales missions

En tant que Data Analyst BI, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • Collaborer avec les Business Analysts afin de comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) pertinents.
  • Explorer, analyser et valoriser les données disponibles afin de produire des analyses descriptives, reporting et tableaux de bord BI.
  • Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord MicroStrategy, en veillant à leur pertinence fonctionnelle et à leur qualité.
  • Requêter et extraire les données via des scripts SQL, à des fins d'analyse ou pour répondre à des besoins opérationnels.
  • Conduire des analyses Data en lien direct avec les problématiques et enjeux métiers.
  • Présenter les résultats des analyses auprès d'un public métier varié, animer des réunions et faciliter la compréhension des données.
  • Interpréter les résultats et formuler des insights et recommandations business auprès des parties prenantes.
  • Accompagner les métiers dans l'application des principes de gouvernance et de protection de la donnée : Data Management, Data Privacy, conformité, etc.
  • Documenter les analyses, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques ainsi que les guides utilisateurs des tableaux de bord.
  • Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des livrables existants : évolution des rapports, optimisation des dashboards et amélioration des processus analytiques.
  • Être force de proposition sur les solutions permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la pertinence et l'efficacité des analyses BI.

Déroulement Des Entretiens

Chez Klanik, nous souhaitons apporter la meilleure expérience candidat possible. Ainsi, nous privilégions les processus de recrutements les plus courts possibles, et encadrés par des valeurs de partage, de bienveillance et d'exigence.

Vous serez amené à échanger tout au long du processus avec :

  • Nos HR Partner
  • Nos Validateurs Techniques
  • Nos Business Managers

Profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure Bac +3 minimum en informatique ou domaine équivalent.
  • 5 ans d'expérience minimum sur un poste équivalent
  • Expérience significative dans le secteur bancaire

Compétences techniques indispensables

  • Maîtrise des requêtes et de l'extraction de données pour les besoins d'analyse
  • Expertise indispensable en SQL.
  • Maîtrise des environnements de bases de données SQL
  • Expertise sur un outil de Data Visualisation / Business Intelligence
  • Une expertise sur Power BI ou Tableau peut également être considérée

Qualités attendues

  • Excellente communication & pédagogie
  • Esprit d'équipe
  • Esprit critique : savoir challenger le besoin métier et proposer des solutions adaptées
  • Autonomie & adaptabilité

Title: Data Analyst Senior
HTML:
Notre client est une mutuelle reconnue pour ses valeurs humaines et le confort de travail qu'elle offre à ses salariés. L’intégrer est la garantie de rejoindre une structure à taille humaine avec des valeurs fortes. Elle recherche aujourd'hui un Data Analyst Senior pour rejoindre ses équipes.


Vos missions:

  • Recueillir et formaliser les besoins Data des équipes métiers ;
  • Extraire, analyser et modéliser les données issues de différentes sources (DWH, CRM, Oracle...)
  • Concevoir et diffuser des reportings, KPI et tableaux de bord via des outils BI ;
  • Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données ;
  • Accompagner les métiers dans l'analyse des données et la prise de décision ;
  • Automatiser les traitements et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des outils et processus.


Profil recherché:


Vous êtes diplômé(e)s d’un Bac+3 à Bac+5, vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en analyse de données, acquise dans le secteur de l'assurance santé ou de la complémentaire santé.


Vous maîtrisez l'analyse et le traitement de données ainsi que la création, l'organisation et le pilotage de bases de requêtes. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils Office (Excel, Access, VBA...), les outils d'analyse de données tels que Python, R et SQL, ainsi qu'avec les outils de Data Visualisation.


Vous êtes à l'aise avec la production de reportings, l'analyse d'indicateurs et le contrôle de la qualité des données. La maîtrise d'Active'Infinite constitue un fort atout pour le poste. Une connaissance de DigDash est également appréciée.


Capacités humaines attendues :

  • Forte autonomie ;
  • Rigueur et esprit d'analyse ;
  • Capacité de synthèse et esprit critique ;
  • Esprit d'équipe et excellent relationnel ;
  • Sens de l'écoute, pédagogie et réactivité.


Informations pratiques :


  • Localisation : Nice (06) ou Marseille (13)
  • Remote : 2 jours de télétravail par semaine
  • Package : Titres Restaurant, bonne mutuelle familiale, PEE, CSE + autres avantages ;
  • Rémunération : 40k-56k€ fixe (sur 13 mensualités)
  • Semaine de travail de 4 jours


La confidentialité de votre candidature est garantie.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Arcaplanet consolida la propria strategia di crescita attraverso l’apertura di decine di nuovi punti vendita ogni anno su tutto il territorio nazionale, lo sviluppo del canale online e delle soluzioni digitali in un’ottica di omnicanalità integrata, nonché l’ampliamento dell’offerta di servizi dedicati al mondo Pet.




A supporto di tale strategia e con un forte orientamento customer centric, investe nello sviluppo delle professionalità che operano sia nel Retail che nell’Headquarter con l’obiettivo costante di garantire la massima soddisfazione ed un servizio di eccellenza.




Chi siamo e cosa cerchiamo




Stiamo cercando un/a Data Analyst esperto/a per rafforzare il nostro team Data & Analytics. Cerchiamo una persona che sappia trasformare una domanda di business in una risposta affidabile, e che sappia riconoscere quando il dato va ristrutturato perché quella risposta sia semplice e ripetibile. Il valore sta nel ragionamento prima ancora che nello strumento.




Che cosa farai?




Primi mesi: lavorerai sulle richieste operative dei team (estrazioni, report, quadrature) per imparare dal vivo dati, processi e business.
Poi: ownership di un’area di modelli dati e report, con test, documentazione e KPI coerenti.
A regime: analisi a maggior valore e proposte su come strutturare il dato per rispondere meglio.




Responsabilità del Ruolo?




Trasformare domande di business in analisi chiare e azionabili
Progettare e ottimizzare query e modelli su BigQuery, Databricks e dbt
Sviluppare dashboard e report Power BI con KPI coerenti, verificabili e standardizzati
Integrare dati da CRM, e-commerce, retail e web analytics, collaborando con team cross-funzionali
Applicare controlli, naming convention e processi condivisi di qualità e governance del dato
Supportare tracking e misurazione GA4 (web e app), garantendo integrità e continuità del dato
Documentare requisiti, processi e metodologie
Allinearsi regolarmente con il BI & Analytics Manager su priorità, avanzamento e criticità




Cosa fa di te il candidato ideale?




Laurea in discipline quantitative (Statistica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia) preferibile
4–6 anni di esperienza in ruoli di analytics o BI
SQL avanzato e nozioni solide di data modeling (granularità, chiavi, fact e dimension)
Power BI, Excel avanzato e GA4 (web analytics, struttura dei dati e degli eventi)
dbt e Git sono un plus
Abitudine a mettere in discussione la richiesta: perché serve, quale decisione supporta, quale definizione di KPI è in gioco
Rigore sul numero: lo quadra, ne dichiara le assunzioni e i limiti
Capacità di spiegare un risultato a chi non è tecnico
Umiltà e fame: vede l’operatività come il modo più veloce per capire il contesto
Inglese intermedio




Cosa offriamo?




Possibilità di lavorare in modo trasversale con diverse funzioni aziendali;
Percorso a 12–18 mesi verso ownership di un’area e ruolo di referente analytics;
Smart Working;
PData model costruito internamente su stack moderno, con spazio per influenzarne l’evoluzione;
Sconti fino al 40% sui prodotti nei nostri negozi con la nostra ArcaCard
Retribuzione 42.000-50.000 € lordi, CCNL applicato Distribuzione Moderna Organizzata (DMO);
Formazione e certificazioni (dbt, Databricks, Power BI)




Sede Lavorativa?




Milano




#Siamo attenti al pianeta, alle nostre persone e ai nostri amici animali.




Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

¿Quiénes somos?

Securitas Direct es ahora Verisure, también en España. En Verisure llevamos más de 30 años protegiendo hogares ,negocios y, sobre todo, a las personas . Con 35 años de experiencia y presentes en18 países, somos la compañía de alarmas líder a nivel mundial. Combinamos tecnología propia de vanguardia con la respuesta experta de nuestros profesionales para anticiparnos a las situaciones de peligro y proteger lo que más importa. Si quieres crecer en unacompañía referente, con un propósito claro y retos de escala global, aquí puedes hacerlo.

¿Quieres ser parte de nuestro crecimiento?

Como analista senior de Business intelligence participarás en proyectos trasversales orientados al mundo de datos dando cobertura a las distintas áreas del cliente, en un entorno de trabajo dinámico con aprendizaje y retos continuos.

Responsabilidades en tu día a día


Colaboración en proyectos clave para la compañía y de alto carácter transversal e impacto en KPIs.
Colaborar con el cliente interno para facilitarle la toma de decisiones, ayudando a identificar el problema de negocio, los sistemas y procesos implicados y desarrollar la solución de BI más adecuada.
Realizar múltiples análisis exploratorios y explicativos con diferentes conjuntos de datos, se requiere pensamiento crítico y creativo “out of the box”.
Preparación y depuración de datos para análisis y segmentaciones de clientes.
Creación de Dashboards, desarrollos en BD, análisis adhoc.
Comunicación y coordinación constante con las diferentes áreas de Verisure para entender correctamente los datos.


Requisitos Para La Posición


Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años en proyectos de BI en funciones similares.
Titulación universitaria superior: Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
Dominio leguaje SQL y experiencia trabajando en BBDD tales como Oracle, SQL Server, Sybase, Snowflake ).
Experiencia demostrable con Power BI o herramienta de visualización de datos similar
Persona proactiva, analítica y con buena capacidad de comunicación.
Clara Orientación al Cliente.


Valorables


Conocimiento de metodologías Agile
Experiencia previa en Python
Experiencia previa con AWS
Experiencia previa con otras herramientas de Visualización y Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, o de reporting como Business Objects

💻Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo (16 días de teletrabajo al trimestre) para que los adaptes a tus necesidades.

⌚Horario flexible de entrada/salida y jornada intensiva los viernes.

🎂La tarde de tu cumpleaños ¡Libre!

🏃‍♂️‍➡️Plan de carrera personalizado anual

🥖Comedor subvencionado, contamos con 3 restaurantes dentro de nuestra oficina por lo que ¡Olvídate de Tuppers!

⏰Descuentos en productos propios

💳Retribución flexible

🤱Apoyo a la maternidad y paternidad, políticas de igualdad y diversidad

🧗‍♂️ ¡Tú eres protagonista de tu desarrollo! Tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar un catálogo formativo adhoc adaptado a tu perfil profesional.

¿Y ahora qué?

Si has llegado hasta aquí es porque realmente te hemos parecido interesantes 😀. Cómo próximos pasos, apúntate en nuestra oferta y el equipo de gestión de personas revisará tu perfil. Si encajas con la necesidad, te llamaremos para poder conocerte y darte más información acerca de la posición y de nosotros.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Coop Sverige – Together we make food-Sweden sustainable

At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!

Within our AI & Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a Senior Data Analyst to help us turn even more of that data into action.

Om Tjänsten

You will join our Analytics team within AI & Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.

As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.

You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.

What You Will Do


Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”


Who are you?

We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.

You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.

We believe that you


Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.


It’s meritorious if you


Have experience from a modern cloud-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code-first analytical workflows.
Have worked in a scale-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
Have experience from retail, e-commerce or another data-intensive consumer business.


About Us

The grocery trade is a stable, long-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson (Emil.Nilsson@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)

Welcome with your application!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Chez PayLead, nous réinventons l'expérience d'achat et l'expérience bancaire en créant des synergies entre les retailers et les institutions financières. Pionniers européens du Payment Marketing, nous construisons un monde où chaque transaction devient une opportunité d'engagement etde création de valeur.

Notre plateforme, propulsée par l'analyse avancée des données transactionnelles, transforme la relation entre banques, marchands et consommateurs. Elle permet aux institutions financières et aux marchands de valoriser au maximum les décisions d'achat quotidiennes des consommateurs. Nos solutions phares :

- Automatic Cashback : notre produit historique, qui récompense automatiquement les consommateurs.

- Seamless Loyalty Card : l'intégration des programmes de fidélité directement dans l'expérience bancaire et les cartes de paiement.

- Easy Voucher : encore plus d'économies pour les clients des banques, grâce à des bons d'achat intégrés aux applications mobiles.

- Transaction Enricher : l'amélioration de la qualité et de la pertinence des données transactionnelles.

PayLead est un acteur de premier plan de la révolution des financial media networks dans les secteurs bancaire et du retail. Nous développons un réseau média financier innovant qui permet aux banques de valoriser leurs canaux digitaux et la richesse de leurs données, en partenariat avec les marques. Cette approche crée une dynamique gagnant-gagnant-gagnant entre les banques, les retailers et les clients consentants : chacune des trois parties en tire de la valeur.

Les banques peuvent proposer à leurs clients des expériences personnalisées, des offres sur mesure et des économies au quotidien, tout en donnant aux marques et aux marchands accès à des audiences qualifiées, fondées sur des comportements d'achat réels.

PayLead aujourd'hui

- Plus de 7 millions d'utilisateurs

- Plus de 25 partenaires bancaires et fintech

- Plus de 150 marchands de premier plan en France, en Espagne et en Belgique

- Des bureaux à Paris

- Plus de 50 PayLeaders passionnés

Tu intègres l’équipe Business Intelligence et seras le bras droit de la Head of BI. Concrètement, la BI est le point d'entrée unique de la donnée dans l'entreprise. Tu travailleras quotidiennement avec l'équipe Data ainsi que les équipes métiers. Mais, ton rôle central dans l'entreprise t'emmènera à échanger avec tous les services de Paylead, des équipes Tech aux équipes financières.

Notre mission tient en trois engagements :

Automatiser l'accès à la donnée et son traitement : collecter, traiter, interpréter et rendre la donnée accessible, pour nos clients internes comme externes.

Répondre aux questions business par l'étude : cadrer un besoin, poser une méthode fiable, croiser les sources et interpréter les résultats pour en tirer une recommandation.

Rendre les équipes autonomes sur la data : rendre les équipes Business autonomes et data-driven, et alerter sur les dysfonctionnements produit.



Ton rôle

Tu prends en charge un périmètre d'analyse et de reporting de bout en bout : de la requête SQL jusqu'à la restitution à une équipe business ou à un client. Une partie de la valeur du poste tient moins à la technique pure qu'à ta capacité à comprendre un besoin métier, à challenger les chiffres et à en tirer une recommandation claire.

1. Faire tourner et enrichir nos rapports automatiques

Nous gérons cinq produits récurrents: des indicateurs de marché aux rapports destinés à nos clients externes, en passant par des projections d'opportunités. Tu fiabilises ces livrables, tu les fais évoluer avec les besoins des équipes, et tu automatises ce qui doit l'être pour que le temps gagné profite à des analyses plus avancées.

2. Répondre aux demandes d'analyse des équipes

Traduire une question business floue en une analyse cadrée, puis en un chiffre défendable.

Construire et maintenir les dashboards de notre outil BI (Metabase), utilisés au quotidien par les équipes.

Produire les études qui appuient un rendez-vous commercial, un renouvellement client ou un article de blog.



3. Surveiller les volumes et diagnostiquer les anomalies

Monitorer les volumes de transactions par marchand, par partenaire bancaire et par marché et renforcer notre alerting pour détecter des anomalies.

Remonter les dysfonctionnements aux équipes Produit et Tech, avec les éléments qui permettent de trancher.



4. Rendre les équipes autonomes

Accompagner les équipes Business dans leur usage de Metabase : où trouver la donnée, comment la lire, quels pièges éviter.

Devenir un interlocuteur de confiance : celui à qui on demande « est-ce que ce chiffre est bon ? » avant de l'envoyer à un client.

Environ 2 ans d'expérience sur un poste d'analyse de données.

L'IA t'intéresse et tu as envie de t'en servir au quotidien pour aller plus vite et avoir plus d'impact.

Tu maîtrises SQL (jointures, fenêtres, agrégations..etc) et tu es à l'aise en Python (Pandas, Numpy, Polars..etc).

Tu es familier d'un outil de BI.

Curiosité et rigueur : tu ne livres pas un chiffre que tu n'as pas compris.

Tu sais « faire parler » la data et la rendre compréhensible par un public business.

Tu as le sens de la pédagogie : une bonne partie du job consiste à expliquer.

Anglais professionnel (nos marchés et nos partenaires ne sont pas qu'en France).



Bonus

Une première expérience dans le retail, la banque, les paiements ou le e-commerce.

Pratique de Git et du déploiement.

Des notions de data modeling ou de dbt.



Échange avec un membre de l'équipe BI.

Une étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d'un entretien technique. Nous évaluons à la fois ton rendu et ta façon de raisonner en direct.

Dernier entretien avec le COO, en charge du pôle "delivery" auquel ton poste sera attaché.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations


The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:


State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000


The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.

EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Vet. Principal Applicants Only.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
WHO IS GUIDEHEALTH?

Guidehealth is a data-powered, performance-driven healthcare company dedicated to operational excellence. Our goal is to make great healthcare affordable, improve the health of patients, and restore the fulfillment of practicing medicine for providers. Driven by empathy and powered by AI and predictive analytics, Guidehealth leverages remotely-embedded Healthguides™ and a centralized Managed Service Organization to build stronger connections with patients and providers. Physician-led, Guidehealth empowers our partners to deliver high-quality healthcare focused on outcomes and value inside and outside the exam room for all patients. 

As a growing and innovative organization, we operate with a high degree of agility. Employees are expected to adapt to evolving business needs, step in to support cross-functional initiatives, and contribute beyond traditional role boundaries when needed. This collaborative and flexible mindset is essential to our success. We encourage cross-training, ongoing development, and a commitment to learning across all areas of the business—ensuring we continue to grow and you continue to thrive as a high-performing, mission-driven team.

Join us as we put healthcare on a better path!!

Job Description

As Senior Data Analyst, you will play a critical role in Guidehealth's mission to improve healthcare for all by supporting the data needs of our clinical, operational, and leadership teams and the clients we serve. You will gather requirements for reports and analyses, then determine the best approach to meet them. You will have access to a wide array of data sources, from traditional healthcare systems to AI-enabled tools, to build incisive analyses that stand up to scrutiny. You will present your work to internal and external audiences to drive better decision making. And your contributions to Guidehealth's data-driven clinical programs have the potential to positively impact the lives of every individual we serve.

Please note: Guidehealth is unable to provide sponsorship of any work visa, now or in the future. Thank you.

What You'll Be Doing


Handling a wide-ranging portfolio of analytic needs across internal teams and external clients, from quick-turn questions to sustained, multi-month engagements.
Working with healthcare data, including claims, eligibility/enrollment, clinical, and supplemental sources, to produce reliable, well-documented analytic datasets.
Designing, building, and delivering analyses that answer real business and clinical questions, from initial scoping through final presentation.
Owning custom client builds end-to-end: setting expectations, defining scope, developing, iterating based on feedback, and maintaining the deliverable over its lifespan.
Developing analyses supporting value-based care programs, including quality measure performance, risk adjustment and risk score accuracy, and utilization and cost-of-care trends.
Supporting a range of activities for assigned clients, serving as a reliable analytic point of contact and building trust through responsiveness and follow-through.
Validating results and investigating anomalies, treating unexpected findings as something to explore and explain rather than smooth over.
Balancing competing priorities across accounts and internal initiatives, setting realistic expectations on scope and timeline and communicating proactively when either needs to shift.
Communicating findings to technical and non-technical audiences through written summaries, live presentations, and clear visualizations that lead with the insight rather than the method.
Documenting methodology, assumptions, and known data limitations so work is reproducible, defensible, and transferable to another analyst.


Qualifications

What you'll need for success


Bachelor's degree plus at least three years of professional experience in data analytics, or a master's degree with independent research experience.
Evidence of strong problem-solving instincts: curiosity about why the numbers look the way they do, and persistence in chasing down the answer.
Demonstrated experience performing analytics on healthcare data, with working knowledge of standard healthcare code sets and data structures (e.g., ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, DRG, NDC, revenue codes, place of service, claim file layouts).
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to work with large, imperfect datasets and to write queries others can read and maintain.
Proficiency in at least one analytic or statistical tool beyond SQL (e.g., Python, R).
Experience building data visualizations and dashboards in a modern BI tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight).
Track record of delivering work that survives past handoff, built and documented to be maintained, iterated on, and supported over time.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including experience presenting analytic results directly to stakeholders or clients.
Composure and professionalism in demanding situations, including evolving requirements, compressed timelines, and difficult conversations.


What We'd Love For You To Have


Direct experience with value-based care arrangements such as shared savings, capitation, bundled payments, or ACOs.
Experience using the AWS and/or Arcadia Analytics ecosystems.
Hands-on work with quality measure specifications and reporting (HEDIS, eCQMs, MIPS, Stars, state Medicaid measure sets).
Familiarity with risk adjustment methodologies (CMS-HCC, HHS-HCC, CDPS, or similar) and their analytic implications.
Experience with utilization and cost metrics such as admits/1,000, ED visits/1,000, readmission rates, PMPM, and total cost of care.
Exposure to interoperability and data exchange standards (HL7, FHIR, X12 837/834/835, CCDA).
Clinical, health policy, payer, or provider operations background.


Additional Information

The base pay for this role is $90,000.00 to $100,000.00 based upon experience and skills.

Position Summary

Member of the project team and assists in delivering readily available and actionable data to inform and influence team decision-making and drive better patient care and outcomes. Provides data support for aggregation of healthcare data, including quality, patient, and financial, to support departmental reporting needs. Supports/assists with analyses, report development, and data validation under guidance from more senior team members. Research, designs, develops, implements, and maintains reporting and analytical facilities in the context of the hospital's clinical and/or financial systems. Provides analytical and technical guidance to clients
