Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies


Workday & People Data Expertise
Advanced People Analytics
Strategic Thinking
Data Architecture & Governance
Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
Executive Data Storytelling
Business Acumen
Stakeholder Influence
Data Visualization
Problem Solving
Innovation
Collaboration & Mentorship
Judgment & Discretion

Title: SIU Fraud Analyst
Description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Health Plan Holding Company, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

Mass General Brigham Health Plan is an exciting place to be within the healthcare industry. As a member of Mass General Brigham, we are at the forefront of transformation with one of the world’s leading integrated healthcare systems. Together, we are providing our members with innovative solutions centered on their health needs to expand access to seamless and affordable care and coverage.

Our work centers on creating an exceptional member experience – a commitment that starts with our employees. Working with some of the most accomplished professionals in healthcare today, our employees have opportunities to learn and contribute expertise within a welcoming and supportive environment that embraces their unique and varied backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

We are pleased to offer competitive salaries and a benefits package with flexible work options, career growth opportunities, and much more.

The Fraud Analyst is building data analytics for MGB Health Plan's Special Investigations Unit; this role uses data analytics for the SIU to find fraud leads. This includes creating SQL queries for known fraud schemes to run against claims data, ad hoc regulatory reporting, and creating reports to support Fraud Investigators.

The ideal candidate is proficient in SQL and has a background in healthcare fraud investigations.

The role will be responsible for creating, refining, and performing various analytic reports aimed at identifying potential fraudulent, wasteful, or abusive claim submissions. In addition to performing analytics, the position will be required to conduct preliminary research of identified providers or members to include public records, contracts, and social media review, among others. The analyst will be accountable for documenting analytic and research activities within concise reports or memoranda.

Essential Functions


Develop and run reports, analyze data to identify suspicious billing patterns, assess the merits of allegations, and present those findings to leadership.
Analyze claims data to find suspicious billing patterns and outliers, using knowledge of healthcare coding conventions, fraud schemes, and general areas of vulnerabilities.
Conduct preliminary investigations to assess the merits of allegations through fact-gathering and analyses of data sets.
Organize data and document preliminary investigative steps with a high level of detail and accuracy to clearly and concisely support investigative inferences, conclusions, and recommendations.
Report discoveries of fraud or program abuse to external parties, as required by law, rule, or contract.
Receive investigative requests from field staff, internal claims associates, and underwriting.


Qualifications

Education


Bachelor's Degree


Experience


At least 2-3 years of experience investigating claims or compliance required
At least 2-3 years of experience as an analyst in healthcare, data reporting or data analysis required
Healthcare fraud experience highly preferred
Data analysis with SQL proficiency highly preferred


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong verbal/written communication skills.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills.
Comprehensive knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD10-CM diagnosis, and procedure codes.
Strong aptitude for technology-based solutions.
Ability to develop, introduce, defend, and gain support for new ideas and approaches.
Ability to challenge the status quo and drive innovative thinking and the capability to successfully implement strategy.

Working Conditions


This is a hybrid role with at least one team meeting onsite per month in Somerville, MA
This is a full-time role with a Monday through Friday schedule, generally 8:30-5:00 PM Eastern Time

As a member of Mass General Brigham, we are at the forefront of transformation with one of the world’s leading integrated healthcare systems. Together, we are providing our members with innovative solutions centered on their health needs to expand access to seamless and affordable care and coverage.

Our work centers on creating an exceptional member experience – a commitment that starts with our employees. Working with some of the most accomplished professionals in healthcare today, our employees have opportunities to learn and contribute expertise within a welcoming and supportive environment that embraces their unique and varied backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

We are pleased to offer competitive salaries and a benefits package with flexible work options, career growth opportunities, and much more.

The Fraud Analyst is building data analytics for MGB Health Plan's Special Investigations Unit; this role uses data analytics for the SIU to find fraud leads. This includes creating SQL queries for known fraud schemes to run against claims data, ad hoc regulatory reporting, and creating reports to support Fraud Investigators.

The ideal candidate is proficient in SQL and has a background in healthcare fraud investigations.

The role will be responsible for creating, refining, and performing various analytic reports aimed at identifying potential fraudulent, wasteful, or abusive claim submissions. In addition to performing analytics, the position will be required to conduct preliminary research of identified providers or members to include public records, contracts, and social media review, among others. The analyst will be accountable for documenting analytic and research activities within concise reports or memoranda.

Essential Functions

  • Develop and run reports, analyze data to identify suspicious billing patterns, assess the merits of allegations, and present those findings to leadership.
  • Analyze claims data to find suspicious billing patterns and outliers, using knowledge of healthcare coding conventions, fraud schemes, and general areas of vulnerabilities.
  • Conduct preliminary investigations to assess the merits of allegations through fact-gathering and analyses of data sets.
  • Organize data and document preliminary investigative steps with a high level of detail and accuracy to clearly and concisely support investigative inferences, conclusions, and recommendations.
  • Report discoveries of fraud or program abuse to external parties, as required by law, rule, or contract.
  • Receive investigative requests from field staff, internal claims associates, and underwriting.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree

Experience

  • At least 2-3 years of experience investigating claims or compliance required
  • At least 2-3 years of experience as an analyst in healthcare, data reporting or data analysis required
  • Healthcare fraud experience highly preferred
  • Data analysis with SQL proficiency highly preferred

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong verbal/written communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD10-CM diagnosis, and procedure codes.
  • Strong aptitude for technology-based solutions.
  • Ability to develop, introduce, defend, and gain support for new ideas and approaches.
  • Ability to challenge the status quo and drive innovative thinking and the capability to successfully implement strategy.

Title: Senior Analyst, Commercial Analytics (Digital Commerce)
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Commercial Analytics team and serve as a key analytics partner to our Digital Commerce business. In this role, you will own analysis and reporting across our direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels, translating data into insights that inform pricing, promotions, merchandising, and product strategy. You will help us understand what drives bookings, conversion, and margin across our digital storefronts and partner closely with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial performance.

Responsibilities


Serve as a key analytics partner to the Digital Commerce team, analyzing performance across direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels to identify opportunities that drive bookings, conversion, and margin growth.
Own analysis of digital pricing and promotions, including incrementality, cannibalization, discount depth, and pull-forward, to inform promotional strategy and investment decisions.
Analyze funnel and conversion performance, merchandising, product mix, attach rate, and average order value to understand the drivers of digital commerce performance and identify opportunities for growth.
Own marketplace performance analysis, evaluating channel economics, assortment, pricing, and customer behavior across marketplaces and our direct-to-consumer business.
Build scalable reporting and analytical tools that give Digital Commerce leadership visibility into channel performance, partnering with Analytics Engineering to ensure data is accurate, consistent, and trusted.
Support commercial planning and forecasting by developing Digital Commerce inputs and channel-level drivers, and partner with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial outcomes.


Qualifications


4+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline, ideally within e-commerce, direct-to-consumer, marketplace, subscription, or consumer products businesses.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale transactional and behavioral data, with the ability to independently move from a business question to analysis, insight, and recommendation.
Demonstrated experience building reporting and analytical tools that enable stakeholders to understand performance and make informed business decisions.
Strong business acumen and experience partnering with e-commerce, commercial, merchandising, or other business stakeholders, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear recommendations and actions.
Experience with digital commerce analytics, including funnel and conversion analysis, pricing and promotional measurement, merchandising, product mix, or marketplace performance.
Familiarity with experimentation and incrementality measurement, digital analytics or clickstream data, and business intelligence tools such as Sigma is a plus.
Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Sr. Marketing Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain. The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners.

At Planet Fitness, our unique mission has always been to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment. And we’re proud of the amazing Planet Fitness team that supports our clubs and team members. They are comprised of dynamic, dedicated, and talented individuals who represent our values of integrity, transparency, passion, respect, and excellence (while having fun!) in everything they do.

Joining the PF family means being part of a company that cares about bettering the health and wellbeing of our communities. It means being a part of a supportive, engaging workforce with an inclusive culture that values diversity and creates an environment where everyone can feel they belong. It means encouraging professional growth and development. It means making true, lasting connections with your co-workers with celebrations, team building activities and engaging corporate events! It means creating a positive impact in our local communities through our Judgement Free Generation® philanthropic initiative. It means being part of a brand that you can be proud of!

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!




Overview

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Data Science, the Senior Marketing Analyst is responsible for supporting marketing strategy and business decision-making through data analysis, performance measurement, experimentation, and reporting.

This role partners with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to evaluate marketing performance, measure campaign effectiveness, and deliver actionable insights that drive member growth, engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

The Senior Marketing Analyst will analyze marketing and member performance, develop insights that drive strategic marketing decisions, build/support dashboards and KPI reporting, design and support experimentation and measurement initiatives, and provide senior leaders with clear insights through skilled data-driven story telling.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, marketing business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for translating complex data into compelling, actionable insights and strategies.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.




Responsibilities

Marketing Analytics & Performance Measurement

Analyzes marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital channels, campaigns, and member engagement initiatives
Drives measurement of marketing initiatives through KPI development, reporting, trend analysis, and performance insights
Develops analytical recommendations that identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes
Supports testing and measurement initiatives including campaign analysis, segmentation, and performance evaluations
Develops and maintains dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and analytical tools that provide visibility into marketing performance
Monitors key performance indicators, identify trends, and communicate insights to business stakeholders
Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analysis.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Co-owns the design, development, and execution of marketing insights and measurement strategy with Marketing Team counterparts
Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis
Translates analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Supports ad hoc analyses and business requests related to marketing performance, member growth, and strategic initiatives.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, marketing science, or a related analytical discipline
Demonstrated experience partnering with Marketing and business leaders to deliver analytics, reporting, and actionable recommendations that influence strategic and operational decisions
Experience analyzing marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, campaign effectiveness, and customer engagement
Strong understanding of marketing measurement methodologies, including attribution, A/B testing, incrementality, customer segmentation, and marketing ROI
Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, reporting solutions, and self-service analytics that improve visibility into business performance
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations
Proficiency with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms
Experience working with modern analytics and marketing platforms such as Snowflake, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, CRM platforms, or similar technologies
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and recommend data-driven solutions
Extremely detail-oriented, efficient, and organized with an exceptional ability to establish priorities and objectives
Excellent presentation and written and oral communication skills along with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
Able to establish and maintain effective, collaborative work relationships with diverse individuals, internally and externally
Dedicated learner with a natural curiosity for consistent growth
Cooperative team player with an upbeat, positive, “can-do” attitude!

Perks

Planet Fitness cares about you and your well-being. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees which includes the core medical, dental, vision, life and disability as well as supplemental accident, hospital and critical illness coverage options. In addition, we are proud to offer eligible employees a generous time off program (including volunteer time), childcare reimbursement, paid parental leave, pet care reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, free Black Card membership, learning and development programs and a whole host of engagement activities. We offer a 401(k) Plan with safe harbor employer matching and an employee stock purchase plan. This role is also eligible to participate in an annual corporate bonus incentive program based on company financial and personal performance.

The salary for MA-based and NH-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below. This is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with a candidate’s professional experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Annual Base Salary Range: $110,000-$135,000




Note to Applicants: We have been made aware of an increasing number of hiring fraud schemes across numerous platforms. Planet Fitness never requires advance payments of any kind for computer equipment or any other purpose at the start of employment. Any request for you to provide payment information during the application process is part of a fraud scheme. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

Strategic Partnerships

No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.


Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst / Data Analyst to support large-scale healthcare data modernization initiatives within a state government environment. This role serves as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical data teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and scalable data solutions.




The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of business analysis, healthcare data, SQL, data warehousing, and cloud-based data platform experience. This individual will work closely with data architects, engineers, developers, project managers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to support the modernization of enterprise healthcare data and reporting platforms.




Location & Schedule

Hybrid: Onsite in Quincy, MA one day per month, with occasional additional onsite meetings




Required Industry Experience

Previous experience within healthcare or state government is required
Experience working with healthcare data, ideally within Medicaid, health insurance, public health, or healthcare services
Understanding of HIPAA, sensitive healthcare information, and data privacy requirements

Gather, analyze, and document detailed business, functional, technical, and data requirements for complex data initiatives.
Serve as the bridge between business users and technical/data teams, translating business needs into technical requirements, data solutions, and reporting capabilities.
Perform complex data analysis, data profiling, validation, and SQL querying to ensure data accuracy and identify business insights.
Support the design, implementation, and enhancement of enterprise data warehouse and cloud-based data solutions.
Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, project managers, analysts, QA teams, vendors, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, use-case development, and data platform implementation sessions.
Create clear business and technical documentation to support development teams and end users.
Present requirements, findings, recommendations, and project updates to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
Support AWS and Snowflake-based data modernization initiatives and help establish documented standards, processes, and best practices.
Assist with BI reporting and data platform training, ensuring end users understand available data and reporting capabilities.
Contribute to project planning, milestones, prioritization, and delivery while working within established PMO processes.

Strong experience with requirements gathering and business analysis for enterprise data platforms
Excellent SQL querying skills
Strong data analysis, profiling, validation, and troubleshooting experience
Experience with data warehouses and enterprise data solutions
Experience translating business requirements into technical/data requirements
Experience working with sensitive healthcare information and HIPAA/data privacy controls
Strong documentation, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills
Ability to communicate effectively with both business and highly technical audiences
Experience with at least one BI/reporting platform such as Tableau or Cognos




Preferred Technical Experience

AWS cloud services

Enterprise data modernization or migration initiatives
Healthcare or Medicaid data environments

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics
Description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst to provide advanced analytical support for our Contact Center Workforce Management (WFM) function.

This role will leverage workforce data, analytics, and technology to optimize staffing strategies, strengthen workforce planning, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making. The Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst will partner closely with HRBPs, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to translate complex workforce and operational data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and technical capabilities, an understanding of contact center and workforce management operations, and the ability to connect workforce insights with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Analytics & Insights


Collect, analyze, and interpret workforce and contact center operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that support workforce and operational decisions.
Conduct root cause analyses related to service levels, staffing, capacity, productivity, and workforce performance.
Identify emerging workforce trends and proactively recommend actions to improve operational effectiveness.
Partner with stakeholders to develop and enhance predictive models that improve workforce forecasting and planning.


Workforce Planning & Forecasting


Partner with WFM leaders to develop data-driven staffing and capacity models aligned with business objectives and operational requirements.
Provide analytical support for short- and long-term workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
Perform scenario modeling to evaluate the workforce implications of changes in demand, staffing, productivity, and business requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve staffing efficiency, capacity utilization, productivity, and cost management.
Support workforce forecasts and provide insights into potential staffing gaps, risks, and opportunities.


Reporting & Visualization


Develop and maintain workforce reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Workday, and other relevant technologies.
Establish and maintain accurate, consistent, and reliable workforce metrics across reporting processes and data sources.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready insights.
Present complex information in a concise and understandable format for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to automate and improve workforce reporting and analytics.


Performance & Optimization


Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to workforce efficiency, service levels, productivity, capacity, and operational effectiveness.
Monitor performance trends and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.
Benchmark performance against internal targets and relevant industry standards to inform workforce strategies.
Recommend process improvements that strengthen WFM operations and overall organizational effectiveness.
Measure the impact of workforce initiatives and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.


Technology & Data Enablement


Leverage Workday and workforce management/contact center platforms, including AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or similar technologies, to support workforce analytics, forecasting, scheduling, reporting, and decision-making.
Utilize Workday workforce and organizational data alongside operational data sources to develop integrated workforce insights and reporting.
Utilize advanced analytics tools and enterprise data platforms to improve the accuracy, accessibility, and usability of workforce information.
Support the implementation and integration of new tools, technologies, and processes that strengthen workforce analytics capabilities.
Partner with HR, HRBPs, Technology, Operations, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and system capabilities.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and increase the scalability of workforce analytics.


Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Workforce Management, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field.
Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in workforce analytics, workforce management, contact center operations, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience using workforce data and analytics to support operational and business decision-making.
Experience working within a complex, cross-functional organization preferred.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Excel, with experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical models.
Experience working with Workday, including workforce, organizational, and employee data for reporting and analytics.
Experience with workforce management or contact center technologies such as AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of forecasting methodologies, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and data mining.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and analyze data from multiple sources and translate complex datasets into meaningful business insights.
Experience with data visualization, reporting automation, and analytical storytelling.


Core Capabilities


Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently identify issues, analyze alternatives, and recommend solutions.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect workforce analytics with broader business and operational priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse audiences.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Ability to influence decisions through data, insights, and fact-based recommendations.
Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.


Physical Requirements And Work Environment

This role requires the ability to perform standard office activities, including extended periods of computer use, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and collaboration across teams. Depending on business needs, occasional travel may be required. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on the requirements of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this role is $90,000-$130,000 per year. This range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role. Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Compensation decisions are made based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and the totality of relevant factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in an annual short-term incentive program, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Benefits

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

Work Authorization

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

What We Offer

At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

Next Steps


If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team


Don't meet every single requirement? At Galderma, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply anyway!

If you are considering employment at Galderma, review our job postings at www.galderma.com/us/careers. Please be aware of fraudulent job offers and individuals falsely claiming to represent our Human Resources department. Our company will never request or offer payment, personal financial information, or sensitive data (such as Social Security numbers or bank details) during the early stages of recruitment. All legitimate communications from our HR team will come from official company email domains and follow our established hiring process.

  • Provide analytical support for short- and long-term workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
  • Perform scenario modeling to evaluate the workforce implications of changes in demand, staffing, productivity, and business requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve staffing efficiency, capacity utilization, productivity, and cost management.
  • Support workforce forecasts and provide insights into potential staffing gaps, risks, and opportunities.

Reporting & Visualization

  • Establish and maintain accurate, consistent, and reliable workforce metrics across reporting processes and data sources.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready insights.
  • Present complex information in a concise and understandable format for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Title: Data Analyst, Routing and Scheduling
Description:
DIVISION: BPS Operations

OFFICE: Transportation Department

TEAM: Data & Strategy

ACADEMIC/NON-ACADEMIC: NON-ACADEMIC

____________________________________________________________________________________

REPORTS TO: Assistant Director of Data Management

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Boston Public Schools Office of Transportation is one of the largest departments in the district overseeing a nearly $200M annual budget (~12% of total spending). The Transportation office provides over 600 buses that transport nearly 20,000 students across the district as well as local parochial, private and charter schools. This is one of the largest and most complex school bus transportation systems in the country. The Data Analyst for Routing and Scheduling works within the BPSDOT Data Team providing technology system management, fleet schedule assembly and management, and reporting and data analysis to support overall effective and efficient routing and fleet scheduling.

Responsibilities:

Technology System Management:


Maintain technology systems related to routing (e.g., Zum, Geotab) and adapt these systems to shifting business needs
Serve as primary liaison with vendors to ensure BPS DOT is:
Using the most appropriate version of software
Utilizing the software to its fullest potential
Up to date on training all necessary staff
Serve as liaison between the BPS routing team, BPS Technology and transportation contractors
Develop and run queries to perform data extractions needed by teams in the department from various data sources including the routing system as well as the district's student information system.
Manage data in all software systems related to routing and ensure data is properly synced with external data sources.
Implement data auditing strategies and processes to ensure data integrity


Fleet schedule assembly and management


Create and maintain fleet schedule that balances performance and efficiency
Assist with optimization and troubleshooting of routes


Reporting and data analysis


Gather and translate user requirements into technical specifications
Develop and generate reports and dashboards for various stakeholders such as BPSDOT staff, the Executive Director of Transportation, COO, Superintendent and Mayors Office
Perform complex analyses on routing data to improve efficiency and bus performance
Collaboration with operational department managers (e.g. Operations, Customer Service, Monitors Unit)
Understand operational complexities as they relate to routing and incorporate into data flows and checks
Support training of other departmental staff on how to use routing and fleet data and technology to improve operational procedures
Participate in strategy setting and development for the Transportation Department


Qualifications - Required:


A Bachelor's Degree or higher in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Engineering, Actuarial, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or similar field
1+ years working in a data management/ technological systems maintenance capacity
Expert analytical skills, demonstrating a mastery of Python or R, SQL, and either Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
Strong understanding of data warehousing principles and methodologies
Ability to create project plans / timelines, collecting input from stakeholders and sharing back outputs
Strong written and oral communication skills, in particular the ability to explain data systems and analyses to non-technical audience
Highly organized and detail oriented


Qualifications - Preferred:

Candidates should have a demonstrated history of infusing the following traits into their work:


Curiosity - We need people to help our organization drive improvement. We feel that this requires a healthy desire to discover how and why things work the way they do. We also want candidates to be able to look for those explanations in data.
Quantitative Orientation – Some people think that everything is measurable, that all information can have a more precise and reliable measurement. This is who we want on our team; someone whose approach to everything is rigorous, inquisitive, and analytical.
Persistence – You will have to deal with messy datasets and new and evolving problems in an operation that is learning how to use data effectively. We need you to be able to work through a problem until it is solved, not until you reach a road block.
Vision – This role is about more than just using quantitative skills to answer other people’s questions. We need someone who can help identify problems and opportunities, and who knows how to ask the right questions to address them.
Technical Skills – If quantitative orientation is about a candidate’s will to use data, this trait is about the skill. We need someone who is trained in computer science, statistics, mathematics, and/or economics. But we also want someone who is constantly acquiring technical skills and understands the value of a multidisciplinary approach to problem solving.
Teamwork – We believe that excellent teams, composed of high-performing team members, can have an enormous impact. New team members are valued for their diverse experiences and commitment to service. They must also continuously seek input from a diverse set of perspectives and think critically about the impact of their work.
Communication – This is one of the most important skills to have when working in a team environment. Being able to clearly convey your thoughts/ideas to any audience is vital to the success of this position. We need someone who can explain highly technical things to anyone.


Terms: Managerial, C53. City of Boston Residency is Required.

Title: Senior Analyst, Data and Analysis
Description:
Company Description

Digitas is the Networked Experience Agency, built on the vision that we create magnetic experiences that earn the right for brands to exist in human networks. Today, and tomorrow. We deliver Networked Experiences by leveraging comprehensive data, technology, creative, media and strategy capabilities. Digitas delivers ambitious outcomes via unique solutions that include Creative Experiences, Integrated Media, Addressable Relationships, Social Marketing and Total Commerce. Celebrated by AdAge as Data and Insights Agency of the Year, U.S Campaign’s Brand Experience Agency of the Year, Media Network of the Year and celebrated by Forrester and Gartner, Digitas serves the world’s leading brands through a global network comprised of more than 5,500 employees across over 65 offices in 43 countries.

The Digitas culture is made up of fearless, inventive and generous Unicorns of all kinds.

Overview

The Data & Analysis team uses data-driven insights to fuel strategic growth for clients. We believe that data should never exist in a vacuum; instead, it should be put to work to bring the best ideas and stories to our clients.

To help with this, we’re looking for an outstanding Senior Analyst – someone who can analyze massive data sets, make insightful cross-channel recommendations, and communicate strategic ideas to clients. Sound like you? Read on.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Analyst, you’ll build the strategic and tactical foundation for data-driven marketing efforts. You’ll work to achieve client goals through brand and acquisition campaigns, site optimization, and/or online testing strategy.

Day-to-day, Your Role Includes


Instituting frameworks across project and campaign lifecycles, including measurement plans, primary and secondary research, and performance reporting
Diving into large data sets, uncovering insights, and providing impactful recommendations to clients
Connecting the dots across channels through data (including display media, site, search, email, and social) to provide a holistic view of marketing efforts
Communicating with clients regularly on scheduled deliverables and ad-hoc requests
Collaborating with internal teams and external partners to drive success for client’s business goals


Qualifications


3-5 years of experience in analytics or strategy
A four-year college degree
Passion for digital marketing and emerging trends in the digital landscape
Experience communicating with internal and external stakeholders at a variety of levels
Fluency with Excel (including pivot tables and vlookups) and/or other data analysis tools such as SQL or Tableau
Comfortable in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment
Familiarity with prompt-based interaction and commonly used generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Google Gemini, DALL·E, Midjourney) is a plus, especially for tasks like ideation, research, or content generation.


Got the sparkle? Apply if you believe your unique skills are a fit.

Additional Information

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent.

Publicis Groupe provides robust and inclusive benefit programs and policies to support the evolving and diverse needs of our talent and enable every person to grow and thrive. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off.

If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact USMTTACompliance@publicis.com.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 11/15/2026.

Description:
Job Description:

Job Description

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

This job is responsible for leading analytical work efforts for projects within the consumer and small business product space. Key responsibilities include leveraging databases to acquire client, product, and performance data; transforming data into meaningful insights and trends; and delivering recommendations that support business and product decisions. Job expectations include partnering with marketing, product, and technology teams to translate questions into analytical approaches, define and monitor key performance indicators, evaluate product adoption and outcomes, and communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities


Sources, integrates, and transforms data across relational and non-relational platforms using SQL, Python, Spark/Scala, SAS, and other analytical tools to create meaningful measures, insights, and reusable analytical outputs.
Translates business and product questions into analytical frameworks and applies quantitative, segmentation, behavioral, and test-and-learn techniques to develop actionable recommendations.
Evaluates product performance and customer journeys by defining and monitoring metrics related to adoption, usage, engagement, retention, attrition, customer outcomes, and business impact.
Partners across product, marketing, technology, data product management, governance, and business teams to clarify requirements, align priorities, support data product adoption, and deliver agreed outcomes.
Communicates complex analytical findings to technical, non-technical, and senior audiences through clear data storytelling, visualizations, and actionable recommendations using tools such as PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Tableau.
Validates data and analytical outputs, resolves or escalates inconsistencies, and follows documentation, control, governance, and business-continuity requirements to support trusted data and consistent metrics.
Leads complex analytical initiatives, manages competing priorities to achieve outcomes, and supports the development of people and team capabilities.


Skills


Application Development
Business Analytics
Product Analytics
Data and Trend Analysis
Data Mining
Data Visualization
Business Intelligence
Data Quality Management
Quality Assurance
Technical Troubleshooting
Analytical Thinking
Business Acumen
Innovative Thinking
Continuous Improvement
Collaboration
Presentation Skills


Desired Qualifications


Ability to source, integrate, transform, and validate data from multiple systems of record using modern data tools and techniques.
Experience in product analytics, customer analytics, marketing analytics, portfolio analytics, or business performance analytics.
Experience evaluating product performance, customer engagement, customer journeys, and business outcomes, including adoption, usage, retention, and attrition.
Ability to define and track key performance indicators, develop practical measurement frameworks, and assess business impact.
Working knowledge of advanced analytical techniques, including segmentation, behavioral analytics, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and test-and-learn methods.
Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for stakeholders with varying levels of analytical fluency.
Understanding of Consumer and Business Payments ecosystems and Merchant Acquiring solutions.
Fluency in Python and SQL.
Familiarity with relational and non-relational databases, including Teradata, Oracle, Hadoop, SAS-Grid, and Starburst.
Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, and ThoughtSpot.
Ability to use AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot Chat and GitHub Copilot to accelerate analysis, insight development, and operational efficiency while following applicable controls and standards.
Ability to collaborate across product, marketing, technology, data, and governance teams to align on requirements, milestones, and shared outcomes.
Ability to adapt quickly, learn new technologies, and apply emerging analytical techniques appropriately.


Minimum Education Requirement

Minimum of bachelor’s degree with strong quantitative background in Marketing, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

1st shift (United States of America)

Hours Per Week:

40

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Senior Strategy Analyst
Description:
Red Oak is a joint venture between two Fortune 20 leading healthcare companies, CVS Health and Cardinal Health, responsible for securing generic pharmaceuticals for both organizations. Pharmaceutical Sourcing team is comprised of industry experts, strategists, and entrepreneurial thinkers who apply innovative strategies to bring generic pharmaceuticals to market more efficiently.




Enjoy the best of both worlds with our hybrid schedule! Work from the comfort of home on Mondays and Fridays and join the team in our welcoming office space on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays for collaboration and connection.




Position Summary:

Red Oak is seeking a data analyst for the Strategy & Analytics team to design Tableau/Salesforce dashboards, manage SQL databases, automate processes in Python, build data pipelines, and perform at hoc analytics to inform daily generic pharmaceutical sourcing strategy as well as longer-term decisions made by the Executive Leadership Team. Success in this role requires strong analytics skills, experience with key data tools, and the ability to work collaboratively across business functions. Experience working in the industry (e.g., pharmaceuticals, healthcare, etc.) is also a plus. The Senior Analyst will have the opportunity to learn about an important segment in the healthcare space at one of the most innovative companies in the industry.

Responsibilities:

1.) Analytics & Insights

Understand how product, supplier, and industry dynamics may impact Red Oak Sourcing
Perform ad hoc quantitative analyses across a variety of topics, as well as oversee recurring deliverables
Compile data and information from multiple sources and translate into meaningful insights
Design and create new Tableau dashboards and visualizations as needed
Communicate findings through appropriate tools (e.g., slide presentations, Excel or reports)




2.) Data Infrastructure

Learn the fundamentals of Red Oak Sourcing’s proprietary data infrastructure
Collect, clean, validate, and process data
Lead change-management initiatives to help adopt new information assets (e.g., Salesforce)
Design data pipelines to integrate different data sources into Red Oak Sourcing’s databases
Develop ETL and storage approaches that ensure ready access to necessary data




3.) Cross-functional Support

Meet regularly with business users to better understand their needs, and educate them on existing tools
Drive various projects across the organization, such as design sprints and quarterly board meetings
Support supplier meetings with dynamic portfolio assessments across a variety of metrics
Execute review of generic portfolio (e.g., identify cost savings, forecast potential changes in product dynamics, model changes in purchasing methodologies, etc.)
Partner cross-functionally to address business needs and create efficiencies




4.) Executive Presentations

Conduct extensive research on subjects pertaining to business and regulatory environments
Build compelling visuals that break complex ideas into digestible fragments
Develop clear and concise narratives that guide the audience through the presentation
Deliver presentations that focus on engaging the audience




Qualifications:

Expertise in key analytics and data visualization tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau and Salesforce
Proficiency in Python and basic understanding of statistical methods (sampling, regression, distributions, etc.)
2-3 years of experience in a related field (e.g., healthcare analytics, data science, statistics etc.)
A bachelor’s degree in quantitative or technical field preferred (e.g., data science, applied analytics, statistics, operations research, mathematics, engineering, etc.)
Experience with web scraping and process automation
Experience with relational databases and knowledge of database management fundamentals
Expertise in building PowerPoint presentations preferred
Exposure to other programming languages is a plus (e.g. R)
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
Ability to connect disparate data and information to identify themes and trends
Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to clearly present results of complex analyses
Ability to work with variety of stakeholders, particularly executives, and communicate effectively
Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn the industry, and tools to grow in your career

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.
